tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir legs par smra bar bya ba 'di lta ste/ rang re sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba rnams la rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin gsal kha can zhig dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab gsar rnying thams cad na spom yor ba las mi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang dus phyis chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pas rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rgyud kyi dkar chag so so nas bsdus te 'dra phyogs rnams bsgrig par mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag cig mdzad 'dug pa de nyid 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gsung rab de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma chen po 'dis rnal 'byor dbang phyug la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis gsan no zhes gsungs pa yod kyang / re re nas 'di dang 'di yin no zhes dngos su bgrangs pa ma mthong zhing / bla ma rnams kyi gsung bgros las ma thos mod kyi/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i rgyud bshad lugs kyi babs/ sam+bu ṭi'i ṭik+ka chen po dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rgyud 'di'i dkar chag rje btsun dang phya pas mdzad pa dang / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung bgros kyi zur las rjes su dpag na/ grangs su 'dren rgyu 'di ltar yin nam snyam ste/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud las/ rje btsun chen po'i dkar chag tu/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ gshin rje dgra nag gzhon nu gdong drug rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste bcu'o/

/shes rab kyi rgyud la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ zla bzang thig le/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ de'i bshad rgyud/ man+t+ra am̐ pa/ bshad rgyud chen po/ mahā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ a bhi dha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ kun tu spyod pa/ he ru ka mngon 'byung / phag mo mngon byung / rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ bde mchog sdom 'byung ste bcu dgu'o/ /'dir rje btsun dang phya pas mdzad pa'i dkar chag gnyis char du/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud kyi dum bu bgrangs mod kyang / de ni rje btsun gyi dus su bsgyur ba yin gyis/ sa chen gyi dus su mi bzhugs pas ma bgrang bsam mo/ /gnyis su med pa'i rgyud las/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po thig le/ rdo rje gur/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid kyi sgron me/ gsang ba'i sgron ma/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag snyog med a ra li/ rdo rje a ra li/ rigs kyi a ra li/ mgon po mngon 'byung / ji bzhin snyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ thod pa brtag pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud/ de'i bsdus rgyud/ dbang gi don/ rgyud kyi dum bu/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi/ de'i rgyud phyi ma ste nyi shu'o/ /'di gnyis so sor bgrangs shing rnam bshad kyang so sor mdzad pa yod/ 'di'i nang gi sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud gnyis dang / ji bzhin snyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud ma gtogs pa'i bcu bdun po rnams ni/ rgyud sde spyi rnam du/ sam+bu ṭi'i da lta dngos su bsal bar byed pa'i snying po'i rgyud bcu bdun yod ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar du rje btsun gyi dkar chag tu/ gnyis med rgyud kyi nang du ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyang bshad pas bla med kyi rgyud lnga bcur byas pa nyid rigs te/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud bla med ltar 'grel ba'i tshe/ brgya phrag phyed kyi bla ma dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde'i grangs lnga bcu de'i dus su 'gyur nas yod cing / de thams cad rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid la dngos su gsan la/ de nyid kyi nang nas kyang bshad rgyud kyi gtso bor gyur pa/ sam+bu ṭi gsan pa'i tshe/ de gsal bar byed pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma dgu yang gsan no/ /dgu ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud la de nyid 'dus pa/ rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog dang po/ sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud chung ngu ste bzhi'o/ /spyod rgyud las rta mgrin gyi rtogs pa chung ngu / stobs po che'i rtogs pa/ rnam snang mngon byang ste gsum mo/ /bya rgyud la 'od zer can gyi rtogs pa/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud gnyis po ni sam+bu ṭi'i skabs su phan 'dogs pa'i rgyud yin pas sam+bu ṭi'i char gtogs kyis/ rgyud sde 'og ma dgu ni/ de dgongs kyang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs nyid bla med kyi lugs ltar du bkral te bshad pa'i tshe/ de dang 'brel ba'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ de'i rgyud ri rab chen po'i khang bu brtsegs pa/ rdo rje mi pham me ltar rmongs byed/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa stobs po che'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i mchu/ gnam lcags mchu/ lcags kyi mchu nag po/ drang srong klu la dmod bor ba'i gzungs/ sog ma med pa'i rtog pa brgyad pa ste bcu gsum mo/ /'di dag ni rang gi ngo bo bya rgyud yin yang / 'grel lugs kyi dbang gis bla med ltar du bshad pa'i khongs su 'du'o/ /gong du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pas gsal bar byed pa'i bla med kyi rgyud lnga bcu/

zhes gsungs pa ni rgyud sde bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar bla med kyi rgyud sde'i ngo bo lnga bcu/ sam+bu ṭi'i char gtogs kyi rgyud sde 'og ma dgu/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi char gtogs kyi rgyud bcu gsum ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis so/ /'di dag kyang spyir sprul pa'i gang zag gis chos gsan pa'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ lung gi zin so med par so so skye bo'i blos 'di'o zhes nges par dka' na yang gong du bshad pa ltar cung zad tsam rjes su dpags te/ gzhan gyi rtsad gcod pa'i blo 'jug pa la phan par bsam nas dge slong puṇ+ya bas bris pa'o/ /don du ma gyur blo yis bslad pa dang / /rjes su dpags te tshad bzung bgyis pa yi/ /dri med tshogs chen de dag bla ma dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis myur du sbyang du gsol/ /yang smras pa/ 'di'i skabs su brgyud pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bsnyags pa/ brgyud rim bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bar du yod pa/ bshad srol rnal 'byor bla med khongs su gtogs pa gcig ni bdun cu rtsa gnyis po yongs rdzogs la 'phags pa rin po che yan chad la yod dam snyam ste/ spyi'i go yul 'di'i 'go nas grangs kyi bsdu lugs byas pa yin par go bar bya'o/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnying ma'i rgyud 'ga' yar dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la sogs pa gsar ma'i rgyud dag pa 'ga' yar yod kyang / la la brgyud pa mi mthun/ la la bshad srol mi gcig pa sogs kyi phyir ma bgrangs so/ /sam+bu ṭi'i ṭīka chen du rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde bzhi char gyi bshad rgyud du sbyar ba dang / bye brag tu bla med kyi bshad rgyud du sbyar ba ni bshad lugs kyi babs so/ /zhes 'byung ba yin la/ 'di lta bu'i rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin ni chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa'i 'di kho na las ma mthong bas/

des na lugs 'di la dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa can rnams gsung rab 'di nyid gzhir byas te slar yang legs bshad kyi dga' ston spel bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po puṇ+ya an+t+ri dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ yon tan dang brtson 'grus kyis rgyang ring du dben zhing za nyal 'chag gis nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug ngan pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag de nyid kyis sbyar ba 'dis bstan 'gro la phan par gyur cig yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba ar+tha'i ming can gyis bris pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir legs par smra bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ rang re sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba rnams la rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin gsal kha can zhig dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab gsar rnying thams cad na spom yor ba las mi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang dus phyis chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pas rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rgyud kyi dkar chag so so nas btus te 'dra phyogs rnams bsgrig par mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag cig mdzad 'dug pa de nyid 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gsung rab de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma chen po 'dis rnal 'byor dbang phyug la lam 'bras gnang ba'i thog mar 'brel brtag pa'i tshe/ dang po rje ga ya dha ra'i gzim khang skar ma phug

gnyis pa de'i 'og rje 'brog mi'i gzim phug bde gsal mi rtog phug gsum pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes 'brog mi la zhal dngos su bstan nas gsang sngags kyi bdag por byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas phyag na rdo rje phug bzhi pa slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes rgya gar nas nyi zer la chibs nas byon te lo gsum bzhugs nas rin chen 'bar ba brtsams pa'i gnas dpa' bo rdo rje phug lnga pa rnam sras phyag mdzod phug drug pa btsun mo rgyu lam phug bdun pa chang ra bdud rtsi phug brgyad pa g.yos ra nag tshang phug dgu pa gur brtag gsang gsum sogs rgyud kyi rgyal po du ma dang / bstan bcos rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'gyur mdzad pa'i gnas te sgra bsgyur lo tsā phug bcu pa paṇa chen ga ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi lo tsā ba gnyis kyis gsang sngags kyi khyad chos smin byed kyi dbang lam thams cad kyi gtso bor mdzad nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i gnas te dbang bskur byin rlabs phug phug pa rnams kyi nang nas 'di mchog tu 'dzin no/ /bcu gcig pa rgyud man ngag rnams kyi skal ldan gyi gdul bya smin grol la 'god pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i gnas te chos sgra sgrog pa phug bcu gnyis pa mkha' spyod bde ldan phug bcu gsum pa phyag chen bkra shis phug go /'di la dbus pa grod pa phug kyang zer/ de ltar phug pa bcu gsum kyi ngos 'dzin 'di/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo'i gsungs bzhin dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mu khu lung zhig gsos mdzad dus phug pa rnams la kha byang du gnas de nyid du 'debs par mdzad pa las/ slar yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bar skabs su dpe ma dag pa rgya 'byams du song 'dug pa la zhus dag legs par bgyis pa lags/ dge'o// ༈ //sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ skyes chen gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar cha/ /gang la bsam yang dpyod ldan yid 'phrog pa'i/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen rgyal gyur cig /'dir snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams/ de'i bka' 'bangs brgyud 'dzin gyi grangs mar gtogs pa/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis 'bad pa cher byas nas lung rgyun zhus shing phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar bka' 'bum po ti dang po la/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la bstod pa rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub la bstod pa dkon mchog gdung 'dzin ma/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi bdag bstod sh+lau ka gcig gur mgon lha brgyad kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ dge sdings mgon khang du phul ba'i mda' dar kha yig lam zab rgyun gyi nyams len/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid byin rlabs bya tshul/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lung byin rlabs bya tshul/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nag po pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga'i gsal byed gsar bu'i blo can rtogs par sla ba/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sngags phreng phyag bris ma las 'bru len byas pa shin tu dag pa/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi slob ma dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor slob dpon las dang po la nye bar mkho ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa gsal ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa ma rig mun sel/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga shin tu gsal ba/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa zin bris/ grib ma chung ngu khrus kyis sel ba'i cho ga thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu bsgom tshul bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul ba sa dang po la mkho ba bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ man ngag lugs kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ kyai rdo rje rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs bskyed/ lam dus kyi dbang bskur tshul kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa la mchan gnang ba/ lam dus nyams su len pa'i rim pa/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi gsal byed snying gi ze'u 'bru/ gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs gtor bsngo dang bcas pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gzhan phan don yod/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi phyag len gzhan phan rgyas byed/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor gzhan phan lhun grub/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi bca' yig bslab pa kun btus/ mkhan chen dpal ldan bzang po mdo khams la 'bul bskul la gnang skabs kyi spyi 'gro/ yang bla ma kun dga' dpal bzang mdo khams la 'bul bskul la gnang ba'i spyi 'gro/ deb chen rin chen gter mdzod/ dus mdos chen mo'i deb bris rnams bzhugs/ bka' bum po ti gnyis pa la/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub pa byed tshul/ mol gtam yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po de nyid kyis sras mchog sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las rim par 'phel te dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rgyun ma chad pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du/ dus mchod pa dger gyi gdung rabs bsgrig par mdzad pa'i yi ge nyung ngu /

rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba/ yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo dman dga' ba skyed byed/ yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don gyi tho/ rdo rje phur pa'i rnga byin dbab kyi brda sprod mthong ba rang grol/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gsal byed bdud rtsi 'od can zhes bya ba sa los mdzad pa la sngags 'chang chen pos mchan gnang ba/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas rang gzhan smin byed kyi phyag len shin tu gsal ba yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed/ drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi gsal byed rin chen phreng ba/ rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi mtshams kyi brjed byang snang ba 'gyur thub/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i dris lan/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha bzhon pa rnams bstan pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs tshul yid bzhin nor bu mthong ba rang grol/ sgrub rnga'i nang gzungs 'bri tshul/ gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma bar chad kun sel/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gdams pa rin chen 'bar ba/ mgon po'i lus dkyil rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gyi khrid kha gsal gzhan phan rgyas byed/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa ji lta ba'i gtor chog dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gsal ba'i phyag len ma 'bring po/ gtor chog bsdus pa shin tu nyams len bde ba bar chad kun bcom dngos grub mchog stsol/ rang srung rgyas pa 'bri tshul shin tu gsal ba/

dpal ldan sa skya'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams kyi dus gtor gyi phyag len rol yig gson po'i skra dang sen mo la tsha tsha btab pa'i yig chung / bdag chen kun legs pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog rnams bzhugs/ bka' 'bum po ti gsum pa la/ ka mad sum cu la gras pa'i gsung mgur/ dngul chu chos rdzong gi rgyal sras thogs med pa'i sku 'dra la snyan dar phul pa'i kha yig ka mad sum cu la gras pa'i sa lo la gsol 'debs/ byas 'gyur gnas bstod/ dbus phyogs su mdzad pa'i nyams mgur mkhyen brtse ma/ byas 'gyur sgrub chen dge slong kun dga' la gdams pa'i nyams mgur che chung gnyis/ yang byas 'gyur du gnang ba'i mgur ma zhig bsod nams chos kyi dpal 'dzom la gnang ba'i nyams mgur/ skyid sdug med pa'i nyams dbyangs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro la gdams pa'i zhal gdams/ chos kyi rgyal po la gdams pa'i zhal gdams/ gong dkar dbon po mkhyen rab la gnang ba'i bka' shog gdong dga' chos rje la gnang ba'i bka' shog gu ru drag po'i dbang chog mthong ba rang grol/ gu ru drag po'i las mtha' gsal byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi dpe/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dzā+e ta ri lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang 'jug cing dbang blangs te slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa/ tshe sgrub zab mo sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid bklags chog ma/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu zab pa/ thub pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba/ tsa turmu kha'i rjes gnang bya tshul bklags chog ma/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang byed dus lung byed pa'i yi ge

dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bkod pa/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka' byed tshul/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bka' gtad bya tshul/ dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba/ mgon po lho nub pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ dzam dmar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang byed tshul bklags chog ma/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar/ gur gyi mgon po'i las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'cham dpe/ dpal sa skya'i chos skyong gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba sa los mdzad pa la sngags 'chang chen pos mchan bu gnang ba/ gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don/ bum gter gyi lag len/ chu gtor gtong ba'i rim pa blo gsar dga' ba skyed byed/ klu gtor gtong tshul gsal byed sgron me/ dkar bdud kyi bskang gso/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang gso'i yi ge rnams bzhugs so/ sngags 'chang gsung rab glegs bam rnam gsum 'di/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /dad dang brtson pa chen pos lhan cig bsdebs/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /tshe 'di'i bsam don mthar phyin bstan pa rgyas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung 'bum dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra ye/ mthu stobs dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /gang thugs ye shes ngo bor ro gcig pa'i/

/grub mchog ded dpon 'jam dpal dbang po'i zhabs/ /gus pas 'dud do brtse bas gzung du gsol/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir snyigs dus kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i gsung rab rnams/ de'i slob bu'i tha chung sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la gsung 'bum po ti gnyis byung ba'i glegs bam dang po'i nang du bzhugs pa'i rim pa la/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub bsam 'phel/ yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa byin rlabs myur 'jug dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i pho nya/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ gur drag bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs bsdus pa 'dod don myur 'grub/ zhal bzhi pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sngags 'chang chen po la bstod pa byin rlabs dngos grub kyi char 'bebs/ rang rig bla ma'i gsol 'debs mthong ba rang grol/ bla ma'i bstod pa phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas/ 'dren mchog dam pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi sku bstod byin rlabs myur 'jug gdams pa zab mo khyad par can/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa 'phrin las bsam 'phel/ mon bu pu tra'i drag bskul dam nyams tshar gcod dpa' bo'i 'brug sgra/ srung ma spyi'i dmod bcol gyi bskul dam nyams tshar gcod rdo rje'i me dbal/ rten rdo rang 'byon lung bstan/ rol mo'i bstan bcos myong grub kyi lag len 'khrul med gcig shes kun grol/ ja mchod phun tshogs dge legs ma/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam bshad blo gsal dang ba skyed byed/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa shin tu bde ba/

bshes gnyen rnams kyi dri ba'i lan bstan pa rgyas byed/ dam tshig rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dam tshig gong 'phel/ tshe sgrub 'chi med lhun grub/ rig 'dzin tshe'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs shin tu bde ba/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las lhun grub/ khro bo'i rgyal po rme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs bar chad kun sel/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs nad kun sel byed/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim nyams su len tshul shin tu bde ba/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi yang snying bsdus pa tshig nyung don rgyas/ lam bsdus kyi dbang rgyas par bskur ba'i cho ga grol lam mthar phyin/ dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul gyi bsgom don rnams phyogs gcig tu dril ba nyams rtogs gong 'phel/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig yid bzhin nor bu/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig shin tu go bde ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba dngos grub rgya mtsho 'di 'phro can yin/ rnams bzhugs/ de rnams kyis glegs bam dang po'i dkar chag bstan zin nas/ gsung 'bum po ti gnyis par bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu/ mahā kā la 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa khams gsum zil gnon/ bstan srung 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa bar chad kun sel/ dben gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi gnas bshad dngos grub rgya mtsho/ bya btang ku sa la'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa ri khrod dbang po'i nyams mgur bde chen phun tshogs/

dben gnas ngo mtshar can phur ri rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rgya mtsho dgos 'dod kun 'byung / nyams dga' blo bde'i mgur/ nged rang la gnang ba'i zhal gdams dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs bcad dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bya btang ri khrod pa pu ṇ+ya in+d+ras rang la rang gis gros 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa snying gtam yid bzhin nor bu/ mchog dman gyi gang zag kun la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig don gnyis lhun grub/ smon lam gyi tshigs bcad ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad bkra shis don 'grub gnyis/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho/ rang rig dbang bskur gyi bsgom tshul gcig shes kun grol/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub kun stsol/ grub chen shrī singha dang mjal tshul phyag bris ma las zhal bshus pa/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang tshul grub gnyis bsam 'phel/ rdo rje phur pa'i las thig gdab tshul ma rig mun sel rnams bzhugs so/ /de ltar grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can gyi/ /gsung 'bum bsdebs dang dkar chag 'dir bris pas/ /dge bas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dus gsum sdig pa ma lus byang gyur cig /de la brten nas 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /kun kyang 'bad med sngar bzhin lhun grub nas/ /rnam pa kun tu rje btsun pa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog tu bdag gyur cig /ces 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can gyi gsung 'bum dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / rje de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gtogs pa'i sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bzhi thog bla brang gi yangs rtse ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas mchog tu legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so//

//sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag pad+mo'i phreng ba bzhugs/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi/ /rnam par sprul pa sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan/ /gang gi gsung rab yid 'ong pad+ma'i tshogs/ /lhan cig bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs 'di ltar ro/ /de la 'dir bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams mgon po de'i slob bu'i tha shal za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la thog mar sngags 'chang chen po la mtshan bstod kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa tshigs su bcad pa/ bar do'i gdams pa zab mo/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam thar 'ja' sa drug pa tshigs bcad du mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom 'phro can/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags kyi lo rgyus sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun bzhin bkod pa/ bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi lo rgyus snyan brgyud ma/ gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gi skabs su med thabs med pa'i man ngag dam pa/ gsung mgur bla ma rgyang 'bod/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i sbyin sreg gi ngag don dang phyag len gsal bar bkod pa las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba dngos grub myur stsol/ rdo rje phur pa dang kye rdor gyi sbyin sreg gi phyag len zhal shes mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig dang po'i blo can gyis rtogs par sla ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba/ dug srung zab mo/ rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po dang nged rang la lung bstan gyi tshul du gnang ba'i bka' shog tshan pa gsum/ nged rang sku mched la gnang ba'i gsang gtor byed tshul gyi yi ge

dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs 'bring po gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnams bzhugs/ de ltar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /gsung rab dri med lhan cig bsdebs pa'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'di phyi thams cad du/ /'bral ba med cing bsam don kun 'grub shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang rje btsun mus pa chen po/ rgyal yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs dngul gdung rin po che gsum sogs rten bzhengs gsar du bgyis pa rnams la gzungs rdzongs bzhugs tshul gyi dkar chag dad pa skyed byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ /oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ gangs can ljongs 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba yongs kyi gtso/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga'i nyin byed thub bstan rin chen gsal ba can/ /bkra shis phan bde grags pa'i rgyal mtshan kun tu 'dzin pa'i 'od 'bar ba/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal yon bzang po bstan pa'i nyi ma che de rgyal/ /mthu stobs 'gran bral pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ /gzhan ngor dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zol/ /bdag gi bla ma grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs/ /lan gcig min par rtag tu phyag gi gnas/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i nyin byed gang / /dus skabs nub ri'i spo la nye ba na/ /zhi dul byams pa'i 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i 'dzin mar yun ring du/ /'dzin mdzad sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog /yang srid du mar skyes chen bgrang yas su/ /sprul nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig phyag gi gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin nyid du zhal 'che ba'i/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa mang byon yang / /kun gyis 'gran bral dus gsum sgrib med du/ /gsal ler gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa rgyal/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/

khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren par gyur pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mchog stsol bar nges pa'i bdag nyid/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / de'i gcung sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam par gyur pa/ skyes mchog sbas pa'i sangs rgyas/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba la bsam bzhin du byon pa'i ci mdzad bstan 'gro'i don du gyur pa'i dus mthar bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur cing / bdag la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ste/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba'i dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi spro bsdu'i byed por gyur pa/ skal ldan dag pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus shing lus pa med par rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid chen po/ khyad par kho bo cag la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pa'i bka' drin che ba las kyang ches che ba'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig chog rgyal po rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang rang la bka' drin che ba'i rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo dang /

rang gi gcen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' dbang rgyal sogs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs slad du/ blo ngan zhes pa lcags mo bya'i lo hor zla drug pa'i gza' tshes bzang po nas rten bzhengs rnams kyi dbu btsugs/ rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo'i nag pa zla ba'i khongs su gegs med du legs par grub nas/ sa ga zla ba'i dkar po phyogs kyi gza' skar 'grub sbyor 'dzoms pa'i nyin rab gnas bgyis pa'i dngul gdung rin po che ngo mtshar can che chung gsum dang / sku 'dra rin po che sku tshab rnams bzhengs pa'i bzo bo ni/ 'phags pa shing kun gyi gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i gnas su skyes pa'i/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams gsum gyi thugs rje las byung ba'i bal po'i lha bzo ba/ rat+na shing / dz+nyā na shing / dha lam shing / kyi na shing / ma bran/ gha shing spun gsum/ byang nas sprul sku re sa rnams kyis gus spro'i sgo nas legs par bsgrubs shing / zhal gser spyan 'byed bzhugs khri mchod cog sogs kyi mtshon rnams rang zhabs su skyes pa'i lha bzo mkhas pa ngag dbang chos bzang / yi ge dang gzungs rgyag sgril byed mi sa skya gzhir sdod kyi yi ge pa kun dga' don 'grub/ dngul gdung rin po che rnams kyi shing sgrigs bzhugs khri mchod stegs sogs kyi shing bzo ba chos bzang grogs mched/ gos dar gyi tshem bu mgon po don 'grub grogs dang bcas pas dad gus kyi sgo nas legs par bgyis pa'i rten rnams kyi sku rgyu song tshul la zangs khal brgya dang bdun cu don gcig dngul gdung rnams kyi bum ldir sogs la dngul khal bdun/ dngul chu zho bdun cu don gcig gser zho sum brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig gdung rten rnams kyi bum ldir sogs kyi phra rgyan la g.yu'i rdo rje rgya gram gnyis/ g.yu'i nor bu 'bar ba gcig dang pad+ma gcig g.yu'i pad skor che chung 'dres pa dgu bcu go gcig mu tig shin tu dngos gtsang ba khyad par can stong phrag gcig dang /

brgya phrag dgu dang bcu drug g.yu'i rdo rje gnyis dang / rdo rje phyed pa gnyis/ rdor 'dra bzhi/ gzhan ma g.yu che chung 'dres pa brgya dang drug cu re bzhi rnams song / de lta bu'i rten gsar bzhengs 'di rnams la gzungs rdzongs bzhugs pa'i rim pa la/ khyad par ba so sor bzhugs pa'i rim pa dang / thams cad la mthun par bzhugs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can gyi nang rten dngul gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la rje btsun mthu stobs dang nus pa'i mnga' bdag 'gran bral gyi skyes bu de nyid kyi sku gdung ril po dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu de nyid gtso bor bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rje de nyid kyi dbu lo stobs che ba dang / sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi sku gdung bung che ba re re bzhugs/ rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi nang rten dngul gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po de nyid kyi thugs sras rgyal tshab kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa sngags 'chang mtshungs med grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi sman sku phyag nas stong rtsa ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rje nyid zhal bzhugs dus nged rang la gnang ba'i tshems la ring bsrel gsar du byon pa ngo mtshar can/ rdo rje phur pa'i gsung bsnyen kha gso mdzad dus kyi zhal rgyan bubs ma nyams pa/ nyid kyis gzhi bsnyen mdzad dus kyi dbu lo'i zegs ma la sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag ris ma'i 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gzhi bsnyen byas dus kyi skra yin zhes pa'i kha yig 'byar ma/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gdung las 'khrungs pa'i ring bsrel sngon po che ba bdun/

nyid kyi sku chos bub ma nyams pa sku dreg can gcig rje nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan skabs sku la bzhes pa'i gsol glo bubs ma nyams pa sku mdun rnams la shangs nas byang sems kyi rgyun bzang po babs pa'i yongs su khyab pa'i dri bsung khyad par can dang ldan pa byin rlabs yid ches can de nyid/ yang nyid kyi sku la yun ring bzhes pa'i gos chen dmar po sprin ris ma'i sku bem shin tu rnying pa rnams bzhugs shing / sngags 'chang nyid dang / mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen rnams kyi sku gdung stobs che ba'i thum bu re re/ rje btsun mus chen nyid kyi sman sku phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ de nyid kyi sku chos bub ma nyams pa tshul khrims kyi dri bsung khyad par can 'thul ba/ rje nyid kyi dbu lo dang gdung tsha stobs che ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'gag ther stod ma bub/ yang sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gzan sbyar ma bub cung ma tshang ba rnams bzhugs shing / yang bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can bzhugs pa la/ sngags 'chang chen pos sku tshe ril por 'bral spangs mdzad pa'i sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra rin po che sku dngos dang byin rlabs khyad par med pa'i sngags 'chang nyid bzhugs skabs than pa byung na sku 'dra nyid dang 'phel gdung la khrus gsol mdzad pas char phab pa sogs byin rlabs yid ches can de nyid dang / nged rang la byang ngam ring nas byung ba'i theg chen rin po che'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma/ spyan 'gug g.yas na ring bsrel gsar du byon pa'i byin rlabs mngon gyur can/ yang bris sku la thog mar rje btsun gyi phyag ris 'khrul med bris thang chung ngu la lam 'bras brgyud pa tshang mar bzhugs pa'i steng star la/ g.yas zur nas rim pa bzhin bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti pa/ ga ya dha ra rnams dang /

'og star la/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung pa/ zhang ston/ dpal chen 'od po/ sa paṇa/ zang tsha gnyis char sku skya bo'i tshul dang / dbus su rje btsun sku mched rang gi sku che ba zhal sprod/ de'i dbus su sa skya pa chen po'i sku che ba dang bcas pa bzhugs pa la/ sngags 'chang chen pos gsar du phul ba'i gong bshams 'ja' ris nyis brtsegs/ zhal khebs bzhi brtsegs rgyab dar dang bcas pa/ sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa'i sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra brgya tshar ma phyag nas grangs med bzhugs pa la/ sa lo'i sku 'dra brgya dang bcu gsum/ de dag gi drung du sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku brgya dang bcu gcig gtso bo'i sku dpung g.yas g.yon na 'jam dpal dang mi g.yo ba/ dbu gtsug na rje btsun gong ma lnga dang bcas pa'i bris sku/ yang sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa'i theg chen spur thal las grub pa'i sa lo'i bris sku chung ngu'i g.yas steng na rje btsun rin po che/ g.yas 'og na sngags 'chang chen po/ dbu gtsug na mi dkyus ma'i sen gang gi rgya khyon la/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs tshang ba'i bzo khyad dang byin rlabs ngo mtshar che ba/ yang rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i spur ras la sngags 'chang chen po'i/ gtso bo sa lo dang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub zhal sprod la lam 'bras nye brgyud ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba'i 'og ltar gyi khrod na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ seng lding nags sgrol/ tshe dpag med/ gur mgon rnams dang bcas pa'i rgyab gzungs sngags 'chang rang gi phyag bris ma rgyas par bzhugs pa/ yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bris sku ngor chen rang gis phyag nas smin rgyas lan gsum mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can gyi dbus nas ngor chen rang gi sku che ba/ steng phyogs na bir+wa pa dang rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum/ sa paṇa g.yas phyogs na rnal 'byor ma dang dkon mchog 'phel ba/

g.yon phyogs na bdag med ma dang 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ 'og na gur mgon dang bcas pa'i rgyab gzungs shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i spur ras la sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa chung ngu bzhugs pa'i dbus na bir+wa pa/ g.yas zur steng na rdo rje 'chang / g.yon na bdag med ma/ g.yon zur g.yon na nag po pa/ g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / gtso thang gi g.yas dang po'i dbus na rje sa chen/ steng zur g.yas na ḍā ma ru pa/ g.yon na a wa dhu ti pa/ 'og zur g.yon na ga ya dha ra/ g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yas gnyis pa'i dbus na sa paṇa/ steng zur g.yas par grub chen bud+dha shrī/ g.yon zur na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'og zur g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yon na rje sems dpa' chen po/ g.yas gsum par dbus su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ steng zur g.yas na mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ g.yon na 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ 'og zur g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yon na ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ g.yas bzhi par rje sa chen la 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus na sa chen/ g.yas ngos na gcen kun dga' 'bar/ bsod rtse/ rje btsun/ gcung dpal chen 'od po/ g.yon ngos na sa paṇa/ zang tsha/ 'phags pa/ 'gro mgon phyag na/ 'og phyogs na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / gtso thang bir+wa pa'i g.yon dang po la/ dbus na slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ steng zur g.yas na 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ g.yon na se mkhar chung ba/ 'og zur g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yon na zhang ston chos 'bar/ g.yon gnyis pa na dbus na rje btsun chen po/ steng zur g.yas na zhang dkon mchog dpal/ g.yon na nam za brag phug pa/ 'og zur g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yon na bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ g.yon gsum pa'i dbus na chos rgyal 'phags pa/ steng zur g.yas na rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug

g.yon na kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'og zur g.yas na sa lo dang sngags 'chang / g.yon na yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ g.yon bzhi pa na sngags 'chang chen po de nyid kyi mtshan ltas gzigs snang la shar ba'i bde ba can gyi zhing bkod 'bri bar mdzad pa la dbus na sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa mtsho las skyes pa'i pad sdong la nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid rdo rje skyil krung chos 'chad spos ral gyis mdzes pa'i dbu 'od ljang khu/ rgyab yol sngon po'i dar dmar ser gyi steng gser gyi dra bas spras pa'i sku rgyab ngos nas dpag bsam gyi sdong po la rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed kyis mdzes pa de'i rgyab sprin gyis brgyan zhing / dbu gtsug na rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi g.yas g.yon gyi sprin gseb na lha'i bu mang pos mchod pa byed pa/ sa lo'i sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi sprin gseb na/ khang bzang rgya phibs sogs myug ge ba mang po dang / gtso bo'i sku'i g.yas ngos kyi khang bzang gi 'og gi sprin gseb la/ bkras pa sen bdun ma zhig btsugs pa la sngags 'chang nyid dang gzhan grwa pa zhig 'byon bzhin pa'i bkod pa dang bcas pa/ sa lo'i sku gdong na pad sdong la khye'u gnyis brdzus te skyes pa'i tshul dang / sku rgyab na khye'u zhig rdzing bur khrus byed pa'i tshul dang bcas pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing bkod la ngag gi dbang po'i rmi lam yin zhes pa'i kha byang 'byar ba dang bcas pa'i steng zur g.yas na 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug g.yon na bdag chen tsha nas/ 'og zur g.yas na 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ g.yon na gur gyi mgon po ste ye shes pa bzhugs nges pa'i bris thang khyad par can de rnams dang / yang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun mus pa chen po'i bris sku rje nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs nges pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar pa'i dbus na rje mus chen/

dbu gtsug na shākya thub pa/ steng zur g.yas na sgrol ma dkar mo/ g.yon na rgyal ba tshe dpag med bzhengs sku/ 'og zur g.yas na nor rgyun ma/ g.yon na dur khrod bdag po yab yum rnams bzhugs pa'i nged rang gis bris pa'i rgyab gzungs rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bris thang la bde mchog brgyud pas bskor ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag nas ma byin rlabs can nged rang la smon 'gro nas 'byung ba'i gtso bor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i dbu thog tu rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje 'chang gi g.yas su dpa' bo rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu pa/ steng zur g.yas su mai tri mkha' spyod/ g.yon du phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ gtso bo'i g.yas steng zur dang po na rus sbal zhabs/ nag po pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ g.yas zur gnyis pa na nā ro pa/ klokya pa/ g.yas zur gsum pa na sa chen/ rje btsun rin po che/ g.yas zur bzhi pa na/ 'phags pa rin po che/ nam bza' brag phug pa/ g.yas zur lnga pa na sngags 'chang gzung pa ba/ bla chen/ g.yas drug pa na mi nyag chos grags/ 'og zur g.yas na rdo rje bdag med ma/ gtso bo'i g.yon dang po na/ dza lan dha ra/ gu h+ya pa/ ti lo pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na pham thing pa sku mched/ g.yon gsum pa na mahā lo tsā ba slob dpon rin po che/ g.yon bzhi pa na skya pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ dkon mchog dpal ba/ g.yon lnga pa na/ bla ma dam pa/ dge bzang pa/ g.yon drug pa na/ dkon mchog dpal ba/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa/ 'og zur g.yon na rje btsun sgrol ma/ gur lcam dral te bris thang ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs nges pa de nyid dang / yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas rdo rje phur pa'i gsung bsnyen mdzad pa'i thugs dam rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di nyid la/ sngags 'chang yab sras rnams kyis kyang gsung bsnyen mdzad dus kyi rdo rje phur pa'i bris sku la gtso bo rdo rje phur pa/ steng zur g.yas na slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas/

steng zur g.yon na gu ru drag dmar/ 'og zur g.yas na dkar mo nyi zla/ g.yon na bdud rgyal/ yang sa lo dang sngags 'chang yab sras rnams kyis bde mchog gsung bsnyen mdzad dus kyi thugs dam rten 'khor lo bde mchog gi bris sku chung ngu byin rlabs can/ yang 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi phyag nas ma'i kyai rdor dang gsang 'dus kyi bris sku re re/ yang slob dpon rin po che'i gter sku 'khrul med grangs gser rdzib gtong byas pa gcig rnams bzhugs shing / bris sku byin rlabs khyad par can 'di rnams bzhugs pa ni/ sa los mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi rnam thar du/ rje sangs rin pa'i phyi rten gling kha dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i byang chub mchod rten gyi gzungs bzhugs la/ rje btsun gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i bris sku zhig bzhugs yod par gsungs 'dug pa dang / gdan sa chen po'i ngo mtshar ba'i rten bzhi'i nang tshan sgrol ma lha khang gi sgrol ma'i sku gsar bzhengs la yang bris sku zhig bzhugs yod par gsungs 'dug pa dang / gzhan yang yig cha mang po na rten ngo mtshar can du ma'i gzungs bzhugs la bris sku byin rlabs can mang po bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa nas/ 'di bzhin shin tu phan yon che bar rtogs nas bzhugs su gsol ba lags/ yang gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod bye ba'i mthar son mthu stobs nus pa'i gter chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i sku tshad sku 'dra rin po che'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ rje nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ lam 'bras brgyud pa/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi nang rten dbu rtse na bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyi bzo phud la bzhengs pa de nyid dang / sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can/ rje btsun mus chen rnams kyi sku gdung stobs che ba'i thum bu re re/

rje nyid kyi dbu lo bub dang / sku sham sku rags sogs mnabs za bub ma nyams pa grangs mang ba/ lhag par rgyun ring sku la bzhes pa'i 'dzang dmar gyi sku gzan sku dreg shin tu che ba gcig rnams bzhugs shing / yang bdag la bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i yum lha sras rgyal mo'i dngul gdung ngo mtshar can gyi gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ rgyal yum nyid kyi sku gdung la yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos gnang ba'i phyag tsha grangs mang ba dang / nged rang gis ched gnyer zhus pa'i/ rje btsun mus chen gyi phyag tsha brgyad rnams bzhugs shing / 'di nyid snga mor gling dga' chos rwa zur du rje mus chen nyid bzhugs pa la/ nged rang gis yum gyi sku gdung dang 'jim pa bsres pa khyer nas phyag zhu ru phyin skabs/ rje'i gsung las/ da lam spur tsha brgyad rang 'debs pa yin no gsungs nas de bzhin gnang song ba la/ de dus rang gi bsam pa la phyag tsha de las mang ba zhig gnang na legs pa 'dra snyam pa shar yang gang yang zhu ma spobs shing / phyis bsam pas ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i thugs mkhyen du snang ste/ dus phyis rgyal yum dam pa'i dngul gdung la gzungs rdzongs phul dus/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi phyag tsha rnams bzhugs su gsol nas/ rje mus chen gyi phyag tsha rnams gzungs rdzongs su phul ba na/ phyag tsha brgyad las mang du mi shong zhing / nyung na gdung kha mi khengs pa'i skyon yong ba 'dug pa la/ de lta bu'i skyon las grol ba'i ma bsgrigs rang 'grig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma bka' drin can de nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i thugs mkhyen la/ yid ches kyi dad pa slar yang gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /rang gi gcen 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi nang rten nyid kyi sku 'dra sku tshad ma che ba dang / rjes su gdung tsha bzhugs pa'i slad du bsgrubs pa'i yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra gnyis kyi gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la sku che ba la/

sngags 'chang yab sras gsum dang / rje mus chen rnams kyi sku gdung / dbu lo/ mnabs za sogs kyi byin rlabs stobs che ba dang / nyid kyi gzhi bsnyen mdzad dus kyi dbu lo sogs bzhugs shing / sku chung ba la 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal rang nyid kyi gdung tsha stobs che bas gar bu lugs kyi tshul du bzhugs su gsol ba'i sman sku khyad par can sku tshad ma 'di nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ sngags 'chang chen po nyid kyi dbu lo dang / spur rus stobs che ba/ lhag par sku gdung la thog mar phul ba'i sgom thag ka shi ka'i ras yug la chab ser dang / sku'i lpags me stobs che ba byon pa rnams phyogs gcig tu zhus pas/ sku lpags pa bre gang tsam byung ba dang / de dus ras yug gi logs la byon pa'i sku gdung gi gsang spu bubs ma nyams pa/ spur tshwa/ spur spos/ spur gsol rnams dang / sku gdung gi chab ser gyi snod bzang sgor te/ de ltar sku gdung gi sgom thag ras yug nas/ chab ser snod kyi bar rnams cung zad kyang ma nyams pa yongs rdzogs su bzhugs shing / yang sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku stod dang / sku'i smad g.yogs bubs ma nyams pa zhig kyang bzhugs so/ /yang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas kyi sku 'dra rin po che dngul sku gcig dang / sman sku che chung gnyis bzhengs pa'i dngul sku'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ rje btsun 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid rang gi dbu thod kyi dum bu sogs sku gdung stobs che ba/ rje nyid zhal bzhugs dus nged rang la gnang ba'i dbu lo bubs/ yang bde mchog bsnyen chen snga ma mdzad dus sogs kyi dbu lo stobs che ba/ rje de nyid kyis rgyun par dbu la bzhes pa'i sgom zhwa phyi gos chen gyis byas pa sku dreg shin tu che ba nged rang la byin rlabs rten du gnang ba de nyid bubs ma nyams pa/

slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab gter lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las grub pa'i sku las byon pa'i ring bsrel/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi ring bsrel/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i ring bsrel/ bu ston rin po che'i ring bsrel/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi ring bsrel bzhugs shing / yang rje btsun mus pa chen po de nyid kyi sman sku chung ba'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ rje nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag nas brgya tshar lan mang du bzhugs pa zhig rje'i zhabs 'bring pa chen po/ dge slong byams pa dpal gyi lag nas nged rang la byung ba de nyid dang / rje btsun nyid kyi dbu lo dang / sku gdung nam bza' sogs stobs che ba bzhugs la/ yang rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun bud+dha'i mtshan can gyi sman sku che ba sku tshad ma rje nyid kyi sku dngos dang khyad par med pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi gtsug lag khang gsar par bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du bzhengs te/ da lta gtsug lag khang khyad par can de nyid kyi sngags 'chang chen po'i nang rten dngul gdung rin po che'i drung na bzhugs su gsol ba 'di nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la/ rje mus pa chen po nyid kyi sku gdung dang dbu lo stobs che ba sku shag bub cung ma tshang ba/ rje nyid kyi rgyun pa'i phyag phreng byin rlabs can/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung tsha thum bcu gcig rje yongs 'dzin pa dang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gdung tsha thum bcu gcig re/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gdan gyi dum bu che ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku bem glegs bam gyi nang snam bu rgya tshos las byas pa bub cung ma tshang ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i kyai rdor lha dgu'i bris thang zhing khams ma la lam 'bras brgyud pa dang /

'dod lha tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal/ nor rgyun ma/ 'dzam bha la/ gur lcam dral/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ rnam 'joms/ 'byung 'dul/ sgrol dkar/ sgrol ljang rnams kyis bskor ba byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub la rgyud gsum bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba'i bris thang ngor chen nyid kyi phyag nas ma/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag nas thugs dam rten yun ring mdzad cing / rgyab gzungs kyang phyag ris 'khrul med rgyas par bzhugs pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i bris thang la/ rje gong ma lnga/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog phur pa/ 'byung 'dul/ gshed dmar/ gur drag gur lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ ber nag bran bdud/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis rnams yod pa bdag gi bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan nyid kyi byes khyer gyi thugs dam rten dang / thugs rtsis shin tu che bar mdzad pa de nyid dang / yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku tshe hril por 'bral spangs mdzad pa'i/ de'i rgyal tshab dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis kyang rgyun ring sku dang 'bral med du mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i dam tshig bris sku/ dam tshig glegs bam/ dam tshig rdor dril rnams dril lkog tshun chad sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag dreg 'byar ba'i dri bsung khyad par can dang ldan pa yongs rdzogs su bzhugs pa'i dam tshig glegs bam rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis 'di/ sngags 'chang chen po'i yab bdag chen tshe nas kyi thugs dam gsung sgrog gnang ba'i phyag dpe 'khrul med yin zhing / dam tshig rdor dril 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i mgul gyi dam 'phrug 'byar ba 'di'i dkar chag yig chung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis sems dpa' chen po gdan sa la bkod/ rje sa chen gyi sku gnyen yin thang zhal bshus kyi sku thang / dam tshig dril bu phyag dril rtse lnga 'di/

bla gos rnga ther gyi sku chos rnams gnang ba yin thang zhal bshus/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi phyag tu bab nas da lta ngor na yod/ sku chos 'phan yul lhun po rtser/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gser sku bzhengs pa'i rten rdzongs su/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'jug pa gnang / phyis dga' ldan pas sku gsham nas bton pa/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i phyag tu byung nas rten rdzongs sogs 'gro phan gang che gnang / nged la yang tshal bu gcig byung nas/ lam 'bras brgyud pa gsar bzhengs 'di'i rten rdzongs la'ang bzhugs/ gong gi phyag dril 'di rje sems dpa' chen po rang gis byang pa rta si la gnang ba rim pas nged rang gi lag tu byung nas/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi dam tshig dril bu byas pa lags/ bkra shis zhes 'byung ba yin la/ yang grub chen nag po spyod pa'i sku'i skye ba rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog zhabs kyi thugs dam ma byin rlabs can na ro mkha' spyod kyi bris sku ngo mtshar can bzhugs pa'i steng phyogs na 'khor lo bde mchog gi nye brgyud/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po yan spyi dang 'dra ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i sku dang / de'i rjes su bsod nams dbang phyug slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sbyin bdag rje rdo ring pa la slob ma bcu gcig gis bskor ba/ dmar po skor gsum dang bcas pa yod pa'i bris thang gi gong bshams la/ rje grol mchog zhabs kyi bris thang 'di dpon drung 'phan la gnang dus phyag bris yig chung zhal bshus byas pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal thang 'di na ning rgyal mchog rgya gar du rkang gtad btang nas ma khugs pa de yin pas/ sbyin bdag ni rdo ring kun spangs rin po che'i sku 'dra yin/ chos nyan 'di rnams de dus rtsa dbu ma nyan mi rnams yin/ mi nag pa phrug gu 'di rgya gar ba'i dbon po drung pa dbus na yod pa de yin pas/

zhib zhib rang mig yul du phebs pa dang / grwa pa'i grangs bshad rgyu yod pa gal che/ rgya bo 'di slob dpon don yod pa/ ga pa 'di slob dpon lu gu gdong pa yin/ 'di ngas rnal 'byor ma'i thang ga 'bring ba mthong ba'i sngon ma rang yin pas/ mkha' spyod rtse mo'i dpon sa rdor mo'i gnang ba'i thang kha'i 'og tu/ khrom zhes pa'i yi ge rnams mtshal gyi bris pa dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs shing / de dag gi gzungs rdzongs bzhugs pa'i rim pa la/ khyad par so sor bzhugs pa'i rim pa bstan zin nas/ da ni thams cad la thun mong du bzhugs pa'i rim pa brjod par bya ste/ de la yang bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs rten bzhugs pa'i rim pa dang / gzungs sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gong ma'i rten thams cad la yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dga' ldan nas byon pa re re/ sa chen gyi dbu lo/ slob dpon rtse mo'i dbu lo/ rje btsun rin po che'i dbu lo/ sku gdung / gdung thal/ dbu thod la 'jam dbyangs 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ tshems kyi dum bu/ mnabs bza'i dum bu/ phyag phreng khug ma'i dum bu rnams dang / rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sku gdung / gdung thal/ bla ma gnam kha 'ub pa'i dbu thod la phyag rdor dang / a yig 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ theg chen chos rje'i sku gdung / gdung thal/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku gdung / mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi dbu thod kyi dum bu/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i sku gdung / sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung / bram ze mched bdun gyi sku gdung / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu thod kyi dum bu/ byang chub sems dpa' dz+nyā na'i sku gdung / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan rnams kyi sku gdung btul ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/

rten 'dam dpe grags ma ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung / bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs nas kha che paṇa chen gyi bar gyi rgya gar gyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi sku gdung / rdo rje gdan/ bya rgod phung po/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ yul chen nyer bzhi/ gnas chen so gnyis kyi sa/ gzhan yang 'phags yul gyi byin rlabs rten tshang ma bsdud par mdzad cing / bod kyi mkhas grub kyang / bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa yan chod kyi bla ma gong ma/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ sad mi mi bdun sogs nas bdag nyid chen po yan chod kyi sku gdung dang byin rlabs rten tshang ma bsre bar mdzad pa'i rten 'dam/ de'i steng du rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs nas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar gyi dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi sku gdung / shangs mtshal/ gdung thal/ spur tsha sogs dang byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ tshogs bsgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ bu ston rin po che/ lo chen byang rtse/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi sku gdung / gdung thal/ zhun/ spur tsha rnams bsres pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rten 'dam/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung / sngags 'chang chen po'i chab ser ril bu/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i shangs mtshal/ spyan snga rin po che'i sku mtshal rnams/

gzhan yang kha che paṇa chen gyi dbu lo/ sa lo chen po'i dbu lo/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags kyi dbu lo/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu lo/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i dbu lo/ mkhas grub thams cad kyi dbu lo kun 'dus/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dbu lo/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen pos sgo rum bse 'bag gi drung du sha sa na'i gsung bzlas gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ yang sngags 'chang chen pos byas 'gyur du lo gsum gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ lam zab dang lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi len pa gtso bor mdzad de/ aṣ+ṭa 'bum phrag so gnyis gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyi sku gdung ril po las zhus pa'i dbu lo/ gzhan yang rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i dbu lo/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i dbu lo/ dus phyis sngags 'chang chen pos rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi dbu skra rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa'i dbu skra kun 'dus/ gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi dbu lo/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi dbu lo/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed la brten nas ki la ya 'bum phrag lnga bcu rtsa lnga song ba'i dbu lo/ gzhan yang yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams dang / chos skyong so so'i gsung bsnyen gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi na bza'i dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku chos kyi dum bu/

sku rags kyi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rags kyi dum bu/ sku 'dabs kyi dum bu/ bzhugs 'ding gi dum bu/ sku srung gi lkog zhabs sen gyi dum bu/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang sa chen thun mong ba'i sku bem gyi dum bu/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i na bza'i dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku chas tshang ma mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'phan yul lhun po rtser/ gser sku sku tshad kyi gzungs bzhugs la gnang ba dge ldan pa'i dmag gis bshigs nas ston pa chos rje kun dga' legs grub kyi phyag tu byung ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag tu phul pa'i sku chas kyi dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi spur ras kyi dum bu/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku gzan gyi dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsol 'ching gi dum bu/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug gi gdung ras/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i sku chas kyi dum bu/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyi na bza'i dum bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi sku bem/ sku gzan/ sku sham rnams kyi dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i shangs mtshal/ shangs snabs/ dbu zhwa'i nang dar/ shangs phyis/ spur ras/ sku 'dabs/ sku rags kyi kha tshar/ phur pa'i srung 'khor dbu thog tu phubs pa dbu'i dreg pa yod pa rnams kyi dum bu/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sku rags kyi dum bu/ sku gzan gyi dum bu/ sku sham kyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i shangs phyis kyi dum bu/ sku rags kyi dum bu/ sku 'tshal gnang dus sku la mchod ras kyi dum bu/ bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi na bza'i dum bu/ snyan dar gyi dum bu/ dam rdzas ril bu/

'chi med ril bu nged rang sa skya pa'i zhal ngo na rim bzhin gyis phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i khri rdo sil ma sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyis bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs rten bzhugs pa'i tshul bstan zin nas/ da ni gzungs sngags kyi rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ de yang thog mar dbu gzungs bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs la/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa/ bla ma'i phyag 'tshal rgyas pa'i spel tshig rig pa chen po'i sngags/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi brgyud pa/ phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang bcas pa sogs 'og ma kun la 'gre ste/ kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ spel tshig dang bcas pa/ kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang rig pa chen po dang bcas pa/ nag po lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa/ phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang gi brgyud pa rgyas pa'i spel tshig 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa/ tshe dpag med dze tā ri'i lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi brgyud pa/ so sor thar pa'i sdom brgyud phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang bcas pa/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa'i brgyud pa phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang bcas pa ste/ kun dril brgyud pa'i sde tshan nyer bzhi bzhugs shing / de nas sku gzungs bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs la/ thog mar kyai rdo rje gtso 'khor gyi sngags/

phyag gnyis pa'i snying po/ phyag bzhi pa'i snying po/ phyag drug pa'i snying po/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i snying po/ gur rigs bsdus gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ sam̐ bu ṭi rdo rje dbyings gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ a bhi dhā nar gsungs pa'i he ru ka'i yig brgya/ rig byed ma'i snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor gyi snying po dang nye snying / 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi sngags/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sngags/ bde mchog rigs drug 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi sngags/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i snying po/ ma hā ma ya gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i snying po rtsa sngags rkang pa brgyad pa/ srog shing brten pa'i sngags/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi sngags/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i snying po/ gsang 'dus kyi snying po/ de gnyis kyi 'khor gyi sngags/ gshed dmar lha lnga gtso 'khor/ dgra nag gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ gdong drug gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ 'jigs byed rtsa sngags/ snying po nye snying / rnam snang sgyu dra rigs lnga'i snying po/ 'khor chen gyi snying po/ phyag rdor gtum po'i snying po/ yo ga rdo rje dbyings gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ kun rig gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ shāka thub sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag rdor thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi sngags/ de gsum thun mong 'khor gyi sngags/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sngags/ me lha 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sngags/ chos dbyings gsung dbang gi snying po/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi gtso bo'i sngags/ dpal mchog gtso bo'i sngags/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ rnam snang mngon byang gtso bo'i sngags/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sngags/

rgyal po rol pa'i sngags/ yan lag med pa'i sngags/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sngags/ shes rab 'khor lo rnams kyi sngags/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub nas bshad pa'i tshe sgrub kyi sngags/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ seng ge sgra'i sngags/ spyan ras gzigs sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ byang sems gzi brjid chen po'i sngags/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs/ sman bla'i gzungs/ mi bskyod pa'i gzungs/ stobs po che'i sngags/ phyag na rdo rje'i gzungs ring / mi g.yo ba'i sngags/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs ring / rten 'brel snying po/ brtan bzhugs kyi sngags rnams te yongs dril gzungs tshan drug cu re bzhugs shing / yang gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring rgyas pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs ring spel tshig dang bcas pa/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ rten 'brel snying po/ rab gnas brgyud gzungs/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ srog shing brten pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi snying po/ chos dbyings snying po/ sngags dbyings snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ tshe gzungs/ 'phags pa byams pa'i dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ rten 'brel snying po/ mdzod spu nor bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ mtshams med kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i gzungs/ don yod grub pa'i gzungs/ shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ sher snying gi sngags/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi gzungs spel tshig dang bcas pa ste yongs dril gzungs rigs nyer gcig bzhugs shing / yang pad gzungs bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs la/ gur mgon lcam dral gyi sngags/ gdong bzhi pa'i sngags ring thung 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/ rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi sngags/ nor bu bzang po'i sngags 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/ brtan bzhugs kyi sngags/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i sngags/

dzam bha lha nag po'i sngags/ tshogs bdag gi nye snying / snying po/ ming gi snying po/ tshangs pa'i gzungs/ brgya byin gyi gzungs/ dbang phyug chen po'i gzungs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ rten 'brel snying po 'dod don spel tshig dang bcas pa/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i sngags/ mchog thob pa'i sngags/ las 'grub pa'i sngags/ don thams cad 'grub pa'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis dang / pha rol phyin drug gi smon lam/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur gyi bkra shis rnams rgya skad du bris pa/ brtan bzhugs kyi sngags/ khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rten 'brel snying po rnams te/ yongs dril gzungs sde tshan nyer lnga bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rten thams cad la nged rang gis tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo re re yang bzhugs so/ /de lta bu'i rten ngo mtshar can de dag ni byin rlabs kyi gar bu lugs su bzhugs pa la/ rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du bgyis pa yin pas/ su zhig gis gsol ba btab kyang mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba la yid gnyis dang bral bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams zhing / /ngo mtshar rten mchog gsar du bzhengs pa yi/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag gi smon lam 'di dag 'grub gyur cig /bstan pa 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad sngar bzhin 'bad med du/ /lhun gyis grub nas bstan pa rab rgyas shog /de lta'i bstan pa'i rgyun bzang skyong ba la/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan bsam pa rab dge zhing / /bsod nams stobs ldan rigs brgyud gtsang ma 'ga'/ /myur du 'byung zhing bstan pa 'dzin par shog /gzhan yang thub dbang rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i/

/gdung brgyud bskal brgyar rgyun chad med pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /lhan cig bde ba can du skye bar shog /der yang spangs rtogs yon tan myur rdzogs nas/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /rab tu 'phel zhing yun du gnas byed shog /ces drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rje btsun mus pa chen po/ rgyal yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs dngul gdung rin po che gsum sogs rten bzhengs gsar du bgyis pa rnams la gzungs rdzongs bzhugs tshul gyi dkar chag dad pa skyed byed ces bya ba 'di yang shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser sngar med gsar du bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar can/ li ma lha khang rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba dang / rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lnga'i bya 'dabs/ dpe khang chos mdzod chen mor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba de nyid kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya'i lta grub la bka' drin che ba'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyi bris sku gtso bsdus chen mo'i dkar chag yid bzhin rin po che'i 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /des gsung lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin tshogs mchog dge 'dun te/ /rnam gsum byang chub bar du phyag gi gnas/

/phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir gsal mdzad pa'i/ /mkhas grub lo paṇa rim par byon rnams la/ /bka' drin dran pas lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /khyad par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sangs rgyas kyi/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /yab sras khu dbon brgyud par bcas pa la/ /dang 'dod yid ches dad pa chen pos 'dud/ /gang gi bstan pa'i rgyun bzang skyong ba la/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin/ /rim par byon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin kun la bdag cag snying nas dad/ /lhag par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen dang / /gang gi rigs sras grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs/ /'dzam gling mdzes rgyan grags pa'i mtshan rnams rgyal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i srol bsdu'i byed po gang / /yab gcig he ru ka dpal mus pa rje/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /skyabs gnas bslu med zhabs la gus btud nas/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen la/ /bka' drin che ba'i skyes bu mchog rnams kyi/ /bris sku ngo mtshar gtso bsdus chen mo yi/ /dkar chag yid bzhin rin chen 'phreng mdzes spel/ /de la 'dir rgya gar lugs la shrī mu kha ste dpal gdong zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la chu mo bya'i lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin rab tu gnas pa legs par bgyis pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can gtso bsdus chen mo 'di nyid ni/ spyir sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa bla chen kun dga' snying po yab sras sogs nas bzung / skyes chen rim par byon pa thams cad dang / khyad par snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang /

de'i thugs sras dam pa bdag gi bla ma grub pa mchog gi ded dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas ci mdzad bstan 'gro'i don du gyur pa'i skyes chen mtshungs med sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro ba dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po rigs kun gyi khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la sogs te bdag la bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis gtso mdzad 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang bka' drin can gyi ma gcig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su yang dmigs shing / bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir dang / bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba ma lus pa dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can du drangs nas rnam grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i phyir 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas nye bar bsgrubs pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can gtso bsdus chen mo 'di nyid kyi bris thang so so'i gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzhugs tshul sogs dkar chag tu 'god pa la/ de yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang bod gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi sku brnyan mtha' dag bris thang so so'i gtso bor bzhugs pa la/

de rnams kyi mtha' skor du kho bo cag rang nyid kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can rnams las thob pa'i mdo rgyud man ngag gis bsdus pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas/ dbang / khrid/ man ngag sogs chos bka' gtso che ba dag gi bla ma brgyud rim rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi sku rnams lha mgron gyi tshul du bkod pa mdzes par bzhugs su gsol ba'i bris thang thog tshad ma gras mthun bcu phrag gsum dang lnga yis lhag pa'i grangs ba dang ldan pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can rmad du byung ba yongs su rdzogs pa rnams la mtshan yang gtso bsdus chen mor gsol ba 'di nyid kyi bris thang re re la yang gtso 'khor ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ thog mar gtso bsdus chen mo'i gtso thang rdo rje 'chang la dus gsum sangs rgyas sngags 'chang yab sras rnam gsum/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus chen mo'i g.yas dang po bstan pa'i gtso bo la gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus chen mo'i g.yon dang po bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi 'od dpag med la nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas gnyis pa 'phags pa klu sgrub la rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon gnyis pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas gsum pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bir+wa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon gsum pa jo bo rje la bka' gdams lha bzhi dang / mkhan po bhu ti satwa dang / bod kyi sad mi mi bdun sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bzhi pa 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la lha tho tho ri/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ 'khon dpal po che/

thon mi sam+bho ṭa/ rgyal po khri ral pa can sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bzhi pa rje sa chen la kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang nged rang sa skya pa'i zhal ngo nang brgyud sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas lnga pa slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon lnga pa rje btsun rin po che la bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas drug pa rje sa paṇa la dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon drug pa 'phags pa rin po che la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bdun pa bla ma bdag nyid chen po la dus mchod gdung rabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bdun pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas brgyad pa theg chen rin po che la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i dbang dang rjes gnang khrid man ngag rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon brgyad pa mkhan chen g.yag pa sangs rgyas dpal ba la sa skya pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas dgu pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka'i bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon dgu pa rong ston shes bya kun rig la shin tu zab pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la rim lnga'i khrid sogs gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/

gtso bsdus g.yon bcu pa bdag chen rgya gar ba la gu ru drag dmar gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu gcig pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan la gshed dmar gyi dbang khrid dang chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu gcig pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu gnyis pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal la 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu gnyis pa glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la 'jigs byed ra lugs kyi dbang khrid chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu gsum pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen la rdo rje 'phreng ba ṭi ya dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu gsum pa sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu bzhi pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub la rdo rje gur rigs bsdus dang / sam+pu ṭi rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu bzhi pa snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa sngags 'chang chen po la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang dang lam gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bco lnga pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la theg chen blo sbyong gi khrid dang chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bco lnga pa spyan snga 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/

gtso bsdus g.yas bcu drug pa grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la dpal he ru ka yang dag gi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu drug pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang khrid man ngag gi chos skor zab mo yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yas bcu bdun pa khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs khrid dang chos skor rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bsdus g.yon bcu bdun pa sbyin bdag la grub chen dze ta ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ de lta bu'i bris thang re re la yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku brnyan re re dang / kho bo cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyis rang nyid byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyong ba mtshon byed kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan re re/ gzhan yang 'o skol gyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa dang bzhugs pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs la sa gnon dang chos 'chad sogs phyag rgya tha dad pa du mas mdzes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs bsdoms brgyad cu gya dgu tsam dang / bde kye gsang gsum/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar/ dus 'khor/ yang phur/ gur drag sogs yi dam gyi lha nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ rnam rgyal/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar sogs 'chi med kyi tshe sbyin par byed pa'i lha tshogs kyi sku brnyan sum cu so dgu lhag pa tsam dang /

byang sems kyi sku lnga phrag gnyis dang gnyis kyis lhag pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/ dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs can/ dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral sogs chos skyong gi sku bco lnga tsam dang / dmar po skor gsum/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum/ 'dzam bha la sogs nor lha'i rigs kyi sku lnga phrag gcig dang gnyis kyis lhag pa sogs dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi sku che chung yongs bsdoms stong phrag gcig dang brgya phrag gcig bcu phrag lnga dang gcig gis lhag pa ste stong rwa can la nye ba tsam bzhugs pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can de thams cad la/ bod chen po'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gos bzang / rin po che in+d+ra ni la dang / btso ma'i gser dang / pad+ma ra ka'i kha dog 'dzin pa dag la rin chen gser gyis leb thags su byas pa'i ri mo/ lan tsha'i ma ṇi dang / 'brug ris 'khor 'brug dang / pad+ma'i sdong bu dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / 'brug rgyab ris sogs ri mo ngo mtshar can du mas go mtshams med pa mdzes par spras pa'i khyad chos 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i gong gsham 'ja' ris gsum sbrags dang bcas pa/ de thams cad kyi sgril shing gi tog dang / gong shing 'gel lung gi 'dzin byed kyi bzung nga dang a long thams cad dngul dkar ljang brdungs 'ba' zhig las byas shing / kha dog sna tshogs pa bkra ba'i sman tshe'i rigs mang po dang / dar chen kha dog sna tshogs pa lha rdzas kyi dpal la zhum pa ster ba dag gis gtso thang nyid la na bza' zhal kheb lnga sbrags dang / gzhan thams cad la bzhi sbrags re re dang bcas pa'i gong gsham 'ja' ris de rnams la yongs bsdoms gos chen yug lnga phrag gnyis dang gcig gis lhag pa ste dar yug bzhi bcu zhe bzhi lhag tsam song zhing / bris thang rnams kyi zhal gser gser ris sogs la gser btul ma zho bco lnga lhag tsam dang /
