sgril shing rnams kyi tog sogs kyi rgyu la dngul dkar nyag bco brgyad lhag tsam rnams gus spro'i sgo nas phul ba lags/ de ltar skyes bu rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing blo gzu bor gnas pa su zhig gis mthong yang dang 'dod kyi dad pa khyad par can dbang med du bskyed par nus pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can gtso bsdus chen mo 'di nyid legs par bzhengs pa'i dge ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu gyur nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dkar 'byams su byed nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs te/ /bdag cag rnams la byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /de la brten nas bdag dang gdul bya yi/ /dus gsum sdig pa'i dri ma kun byang nas/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rab rgyas shog /de rgyun bskal bar rigs brgyud dri med kyis/ /rgyun du skyong zhing gong nas gong 'phel te/ /sa skya pa yi lta grub dri med kyis/ /gangs can ljongs 'di kun kyang khyab gyur cig /bdag cag dpon slob tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /'bral med lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /yi dam zhi khro rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam can bka' srung rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lta grub la bka' drin che ba'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyi bris sku gtso bsdus chen mo'i dkar chag yid bzhin rin po che'i 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di yang /

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi mkhas pa/ ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag gsum dang bdun gyis lhag pa lon pa'i dpal gdong zhes bya ba chu mo bya'i lo/ dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i spyi thes su phan par dmigs nas bzhengs pa'i bris sku ngo mtshar can gtso bsdus chen mo bzhengs pa gegs med du mthar phyin pa'i dge mtshan gyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i tshe snron gyi zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod kyi blo mig rab tu gsal zhing ā k+ṣa ra'i 'du byed la phul du phyin pa'i shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /ma mā u puṣ+ya dz+nyā na shrī bhu ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ ma hā mu tra pa ra ma sid+dhi prastā ku ru swāhā/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzod/ gzhi tshugs/ /sarba su kha bha wan+tu/ thams cad dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ //rje mus chen gyi dngul sku khyad par gyi gzungs bzhugs kyi tho bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus pa/ /kun gyi spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po gang / /yab gcig he ru ka dpal mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la snying nas 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid kyi 'dra sku dngul gar bu lugs las grub pa/ bzo khyad ngo mtshar can/

sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bzhengs pa 'di nyid la/ gzungs bzhugs khyad par can rnams bzhugs pa'i tho la/ dbu gzungs la bde kye gtso bor gyur pa'i bla gzungs cha tshang / sku gzungs dang bar gzungs la bde kye gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi gsang sngags zab mo rnams dang / gzungs chen lnga sogs zab la mang ba/ pad gzungs/ chos skyong nor lha dpal mchog bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ gnod sbyin pho mo sogs kyi gzungs sngags rnams dang / lhag par nged rang gis tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang byin rlabs rten bzhugs pa la/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / dga' ldan nas byon pa'i slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab gter lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las grub pa'i sku las byon pa'i ring bsrel/ rje btsun chen po'i dbu thod las 'jam dbyangs kyi sku rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ rje btsun gyi tshems kyi dum bu/ gnam kha 'ub pa'i dbu thod la phyag rdor dang a yig rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi ring bsrel/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyi ring bsrel/ bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi ring bsrel/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid rang gi dbu thod gyi dum bu sogs sku gdung stobs che ba dang / rje de nyid zhal bzhugs dus nged rang la gnang ba'i dbu lo bubs/ yang bde mchog bsnyen chen mdzad dus sogs kyi dbu lo stobs che ba/ rje nyid kyi brgyud pa'i sgom zhwa phyi gos chen gyis byas pa sku dreg shin tu che ba nged rang la byin rlabs rten du gnang ba de nyid bubs ma nyams pa/ yang 'phel gdung gi bye ma/ sa lo chen po/ theg chen rin po che/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/

rgya gar shes bzang / bdag chen blo gros pa rnams kyi gdung rus btul ma sbyar ba'i ril bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal cher gyi gdung dang dbu lo sbyar ba'i ril bu/ sems dpa' chen po'i gdung / rgyal tshab dam pa'i gdung / bdag chen grags blo'i gdung / 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho ba'i gdung / bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i gdung / bram ze mched bdun gyi gdung dang ring bsrel gyi dum bu/ bse mkhar pa'i gdung / nyan chen pa'i gdung / chos rje sa paṇa gyi gdung / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i gdung / rje mus chen gyi sku gzan dang sku rags kyi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku sgom dang sku'i ang rag gi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chen po dang sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gdung stobs che ba/ rje sa paṇa gyi gdung thal ring bsrel ma/ rje btsun grags pa'i phyag 'phreng 'phreng khug gi dum bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gdung / rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi shangs mtshal dang chab ser ril bu/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdung / rje rin chen chos 'phel ba'i gdung / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gdung / rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi gdung / rje yongs 'dzin tshems kyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i dbu thod kyi dum bu/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i phyag sen/ bram ze dri med snying po'i phyag mdzub kyi rkang 'om bu glang mar na gter du bzhugs pa gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i dum bu/ theg chen pa'i gdung thal/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i gdung / theg chen chos rje'i sku sha stobs che ba/ ma gcig sangs rgyas ri ma'i sku sha chos rje g.yag pa'i gdung / slob dpon pad+ma'i tshe ril/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/

rje lha mchog seng ge sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chen po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rnams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu stobs che ba/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i gdung / zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rje'i gdung / bla ma mnyam med chen po'i gdung / paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i gdung / paṇa chen shākya shrī'i dbu lo/ sa lo'i dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen pos bde kye gnyis kyi gsung bsnyen gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ yang sngags 'chang chen pos sgo rum bse 'bag gi drung du sha sa na'i gsung bzlas gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ yang sngags 'chang chen pos byas 'gyur du lo gsum gnang dus kyi dbu lo dang / lam zab dang lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi len pa gtso bor mdzad de aṣ+ṭa 'bum phrag so gnyis gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyi sku gdung ril bu las zhus pa'i dbu lo/ rje btsun grags pa'i dbu lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu lo/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che'i dbu lo/ ngag dbang chos grags kyi dbu lo/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbu lo/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbu lo/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i dbu lo/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i dbu lo/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi dbu lo/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i dbu lo/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i dbu lo/ gzhan yang dus phyis sngags 'chang chen pos rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi dbu lo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa'i dbu skra kun 'dus ltos che ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang sa chen thun mong ba'i sku bem dum bu/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i na bza'i dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku chos tshang ma/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'phan yul lhun po rtser/ gser sku sku tshad kyi gzungs bzhugs la gnang ba dga' ldan pa'i dmag gi

chos rje kun dga' legs grub kyi phyag tu byung ba sngags 'chang chen por phul ba'i sku chos kyi dum bu/ yang rdo rje 'chang gi sku rags kyi dum bu/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos kyi dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi spur ras/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku gzan dum bu/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku chings dum bu/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug gi gdung ras/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i sku chos kyi dum bu/ rgyal sras thogs med pa dang / kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyi na bza'i dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi sku bem/ sku gzan sku sham rnams kyi dum bu/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i shangs mtshal/ shangs snabs/ dbu zhwa'i nang dar/ shangs phyis/ spur ras/ sku rags kha tshar/ phur pa'i srung 'khor dbu thog tu phub pa dbu'i sku drag yod pa rnams kyi dum bu rnams bzhugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan mus pa chen po yi/ /sku brnyan dngos dang 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar can/ /grangs med byin rlabs rin chen gter gyur 'di/ /ngag dbang kun dgas dad pa'i mthu las bskrun/ /skyon med bla ma dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /zab rgyas gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod bzung nas/ /dngos grub thams cad bla ma kho na las/ /gzhan du mi re dam pa'i rnam thar yin/ /tshul 'di sngon tshe dpyod ldan yongs la grags/ /deng dus kho bo'i spyod yul las gzhan gang / /de phyir dam pa'i mgon gyis nyer bzung nas/ /shes nas dad pa thob 'di skal ba bzang / /zhes pa 'di ni/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po de nyid zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan nas lo lnga lon pa chu khyi zla ba lnga pa'i rje bla ma de nyid kyi dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba la khad nye ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/

khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po de nyid kyi dngul sku gsar bzhengs la gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas bgyis pa'i nyin yi ge 'di yang bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bsam pa don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /legs par byas pa'i bsod nams 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal dang / chos rgyal mthu stobs dbang po sku mched kyi dgongs rdzogs dngul gdung gsar bzhengs kyi gzungs bzhugs dkar chag bzhugs/ /bla ma dam pa thams cad kyis dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ sarba saṅgu ra waḥsarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos rje dang / /gang gi rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs sku mched zhabs/ /rgyal ba mus pa chen por gus btud nas/ /rten mchog gsar bzhengs gzungs bzhugs dkar chag bri/ /de la 'dir myos ldan zhes grags sa mo yos kyi lo/ lha mi'i 'dren pa dpal ldan sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi nang rten du dngul gdung rin po che phal thog lhag tsam dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po chos rgyal bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po sde'i dgongs rdzogs su gong gi dngul gdung las cung chung ba'i gdung rten ngo mtshar can/ yang bdag po phun tshogs bsod nams lhun grub sku mched kyi dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i gdung rten khyad par can gcig rnams gsar du bzhengs pa'i so so'i gzungs bzhugs kyi bzhugs tshul la/ sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi nang rten dngul gdung rin po che'i gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la gtso gcen rin po che de nyid kyi gdung rus thams cad mchod rten brgya rtsa ma dang /

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku/ tshe dpag med kyi sku 'ba' zhig spar du btab pa la na bza' gser dngul gsol ba dang / gzungs gzhan tsha tshang dang bcas pas sku'i nang thams cad go mtshams med par gtams nas bzhugs pa'i yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi gser sku rkang gang lhag tsam pa zhig dngul gyi sgo khyim du kun gyi mngon gyur du bzhugs shing / chos rgyal chen po bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po sde'i nang rten gyi sgo khyim du sngon sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rten bzhengs skabs su bzo phud du bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku rkang gang tsam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched kyis gzungs bzhugs phyag nas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba nyid bzhugs su gsol zhing / bdag po phun tshogs bsod nams lhun grub sku mched kyi gdung rten gyi sgo khyim du rgyal ba byams pa'i sku bod li rnying ma sngags 'chang chen po yab sras kyi gzim chung mchod bshom gyi rten gral la bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs can de nyid bzhugs shing / gzhan yang kye rdor lha dgu'i bum sku rgya gar ma ngo mtshar bzo khyad can gcig slob dpon pad+ma/ sngags 'chang chen po/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims sogs bla ma'i sku du ma dang / thub pa/ sman bla/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ byams pa/ dzam+bha la/ mchod rten rgya gar ma mang ba/ rnam rgyal sku sogs gser sku dang li ma'i rigs che chung 'dres pa bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud/ bde mchog rtsa bshad/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ thams cad gsang ba/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sogs gzungs bsdus po ti che ba/ don zhags cho ga zhib mo/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo las thams cad grub pa/

khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ brgyad stong pa/ mdo sdud pa/ gser 'od dam chen/ bde mchog skor gyi rgya gzhung mang po sogs mdo sngags kyi gsung rab po ti nyi shu rtsa grangs shig bzhugs shing / bris thang byin rlabs can bzhugs pa la/ rje sa chen yab sras zhal sprod la lam 'bras brgyud pa/ gur mgon sogs 'dod lhas bskor ba/ sgo rum sgam nag nas spyan drangs pa rje btsun sku mched kyi phyag nas bzhugs nges pa na bza' du ma dang bcas pa gcig dang / slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i thugs dam 'khrul med bde mchog gi bris thang che ba gcig bzhugs shing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung re re/ bla ma gong ma'i gdung rus/ gdung tsha/ na bza'/ dbu lo sogs kyi byin rlabs 'dzom pa'i thum bu/ dbu gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs rnams bzhugs che ba cha tshang re gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar du bzhugs pa la nged rang rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob bcu phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyis rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du bgyis pas/ 'gro ba lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar bzhugs pa lags/ 'dir smras pa/ legs byas 'di'i mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don/ /yid bzhin 'grub nas srid pa ji srid par/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa rgyas byed shog /hista su khash+tsa kā ra bud+dha de sha bista ra bha wa sarba sid+dha m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ phan pa yang dag pa'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnam par rgyas par mdzod/ dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsal du gsol/ sarba maṅga laṃ// thams cad bkra shis// ༈ //dngos grub gling gi mgon khang gi 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge bzhugs pas phrin las rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/

mgon khang dngos grub gling 'di nyid dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med yang phur gnyis kyi srung ma chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod 'phreng can mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin pas na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi sku ring la 'khon rog gi thugs dam 'khrul med dkar mo nyi zla'i bris 'bur gyi sku/ spyan gzigs gtor tshogs dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ dus phyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dbang rin chen gyis dkar mo nyi zla'i bris thang gsar bzhengs mdzad de/ de dang dus mnyam du kho bo cag gi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de sku gzhon nu'i dus su sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin phyag bzo 'dres med gnang ba'i thugs dam gtor ma ngo mtshar can gyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di nyid 'dzugs par mdzad cing / de rjes sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis kyang mgon khang gi logs bris sogs zhal bkod phul du phyin pa mdzad pa de dag gi zhabs 'degs dmigs nas/ dkar mo nyi zla'i bris thang rnying ma tshon 'tshogs ma 'khon rog gi thugs dam 'khrul med ri mo ngo mtshar can byin rlabs shin tu che ba 'di nyid dang / gzhan yang phur srung bcu gnyis/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i bris thang lnga po 'di/ 'khon sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du mgon khang dngos grub gling 'dir bzhugs su gsol ba yin pas/ don ma go 'dras bris thang 'di rnams phyi 'khyar byas pa byung na/ dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung bcu gnyis dang bcas pas tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ kal+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ /dbu rtser gser 'phan phul ba'i dkar chag bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang gi gtso bo dbu rtse gsar rnying na bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba gdon mi za ba'i yid ches can bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog bgrang ba las 'das pa'i drung du mchod rdzas yid 'phrog rin chen gser gyi lheb mo leb thags su byas pa lta bu'i gos 'phan ngo mtshar can bcu phrag gsum dang /

lnga phrag gcig gis lhag pa 'dis gtsos pa'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di dag dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad gus chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'bul la/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bde mchog pho brang gi gtsug lag khang mgon khang dang bcas pa zhig gso byas pa'i dkar chag bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra shrī dharma swa mi ye na maḥ rdo rje 'chang dngos mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po dang / /de sras mkha' spyod dbang po bsod nams rtse/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i mtshan rnams phyag gi gnas/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen dang / /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /kun dga' rin chen rnam thar bsam bzhin dad/ /gang gi thugs sras bsod nams dbang po dang / /sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab grags pa'i mtshan/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byang chub bar du skyobs/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang 'di nyid sngon slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo bde ba can du gshegs pa'i gzim khang gi shul du/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' bzhin/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gtsug lag khang skyed mos tshal dang bcas pa sngon med gsar du bskrun par mdzad de/

lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing gzhan las ngo mtshar che bar bzhugs pa las/ dus phyis lo mang lon pa dang / me tog ra ba'i nyer mkho'i chu rnams bzhu 'khyags kyi dbang las/ lha khang mgon khang sogs shin tu nyen pas nyams gso'i zhabs tog mi byed ka med shar ba nas/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma spyi dang / khyad par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas blang ste/ lha khang steng 'og gi logs kyi bris sku rnams la arga'i cho ga bla ma'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin bgyis te/ gtsug lag khang gi 'gram rtsa ba nas bslangs te/ brtan zhing brjid chags pa/ lhun po lta bur bgyis pa'i bla ma lha khang du bris sku sngar yod rnams ma nyams pa'i steng / kha skong gi bla ma'i sku mang po dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod sogs gsar du bzhengs te/ bla ma'i sku bris 'bur sdom pa'i/ sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kyai gnyis kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa cha tshang ba bar ma chad pa bzhugs par byas shing / mgon khang du yang sngar kyi logs bris kyi sku rags bsdus yod pa rnams nyams med kyi steng du/ gur gyi mgon po/ 'dod khams lha mo gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs/ zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa dang / mgon po rang gi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi bris sku gsar du bzhengs te/ nged rang rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du bgyis te/ 'gro ba lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa 'di ni/ rgya gar lugs la yu bā zhes bya zhing / rgya nag lugs la shing mo phag gi lo gtsug lag khang gi 'grams bting pa nas bzung 'phags pa'i yul du dhā raḥzhes grags shing /

rgya nag pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo'i smin drug gi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la gegs med du grub pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du bde legs su gyur cig legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /shin tu lus brtas dbang po rab gsal bas/ /sngar bzhin sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed shog /rigs brgyud gtsang ma lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /myur du 'byung zhing de dag brgyud bcas kyis/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun 'di nyid/ /legs par 'dzin zhing gong nas gong 'phel shog /chos med bdag dang bdag la yid gtad pa'i/ /gdul byar bcas rnams phyi ma lhan cig par/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du legs skye zhing / /bsam yas sprul pas srid mthar bstan 'dzin shog /shu bham̐ mastu sarba dza ga tam̐// ༈ //bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin lha khang du mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra rin po che sogs bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs kyi dkar chag bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ 'dir sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta'i lo/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag cig dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su rje nyid kyi 'dra sku zhig bzhengs pa'i/ rten de gnyis kyi gzungs bzhugs thor bkod pa la/ gnyis ka la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gnyis re/ dbu gzungs/ thugs gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs sogs gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar gyi gzungs rnams cha tshang ba re re/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i dam rdzas ril bu khri rdo re/ sngags 'chang chen po dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i dam rdzas ril bu sil ma thum re/ bla ma gong ma'i dbu skra kun 'dus dang / na bza' kun 'dus/ khyad par sngags 'chang chen po dang / yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rus dang /

grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i dbu lo/ yab sras de gsum gyi na bza' stobs che ba/ rje mus chen gyi phyag phreng brgya rtsa ma nas phyag skor re tsam re dang / na bza'i dum bu tshan che ba/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge sogs ngor pa mkhan rabs phal cher gyi gdung tsha 'khrul med bcu gcig re sku gnyis char la bzhugs shing / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra rin po che'i thugs kar rje de nyid kyi thugs ril po byon pa ma nyams pa dang / sku sha ltos che ba byon pa gdung rus dang lhan cig na bzas btum pa sa bro'i bzhi cha tsam gyi tshad dang mnyam pa bzhugs shing / rje nyid kyi gdung tsha 'jam dbyangs dang / tshe dpag med kyi sku dngul gyi na bza' gsol ba lnga bcu nga bdun/ rje byams chen rab 'byams pa'i sku 'phyar gos lu ham̐ las grub pa sku dreg can/ rje mkhan chen nyid kyi sku tshe gtan gang bla med kyi dbang gnang tshad dang / las gral mdzad dus thams cad sku la rgyun bzhes mdzad cing / mthar zhing brjes dus sku gdung gi na bzar phul 'dug par/ thugs dam grol dus dbu gtsug 'phags pa dang bstun shangs nas byang sems mang du babs pa'i rjes dang bcas shing / dri bzang khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs can de nyid bubs ma nyams pa dang / rje nyid kyi dbu lo bubs dbu zhwa paṇa zhwa gos chen las byas pa sku dreg can yongs rdzogs/ gdung rten rgya gar ma 'ga' shas dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / nged rang gi 'dra 'bag la bris thang byin rlabs can 'ga' bzhugs pa'i/ thog mar sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam phyag nas ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bris thang bdun bzhugs pa'i gtso thang la rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ gcung rdo rje rin chen/ yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu/ sa lo pad sdong la sku khyel mdzad pa dang / seng ge la chibs pa gnyis/

sngags 'chang nyid rab byung gi cha lugs/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas pa/ g.yas dang po la sprin gseb nas sa lo gnyis/ yi dam kye rdor/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ rje sa chen/ sngags 'chang chen po sngags chas bzhes pa/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas pa/ g.yon dang po la ri brag gi gseb na sa lo gnyis/ yi dam bde mchog 'khon dge mthong / 'khon bal po/ 'khon shākya blo gros/ 'khon shes rab tshul khrims/ slob dpon rtse mo/ sngags 'chang nyid sngags chas bzhes pa/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas pa/ g.yas gnyis pa la/ sa lo gnyis/ gcig sprin gseb kyi khang bzang na bzhugs shing / gcig byas 'gyur na bzhugs dus bar snang la 'phur nas byon pa'i bkod pa/ yi dam tshe dpag med/ chos rje sa paṇa/ bu lung pa kun rdor/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ sngags 'chang nyid rab byung gi cha lugs/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas/ g.yon gnyis pa la/ sa lo gnyis nam mkha' na pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ yi dam gshed dmar/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje btsun chen po/ gcung dpal chen 'od po/ zangs tsha bsod rgyal/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ sngags 'chang nyid rab byung gi cha lugs/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas pa/ g.yas gsum pa la/ spang dang g.ya' ri'i ngos la sa lo gnyis/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral/ sngags 'chang nyid rab byung gi cha lugs/ nye gnas kun tshe dang bcas pa/ g.yon gsum pa la/ sa lo chung ba gnyis brag steng du bzhugs pa/ gtso bo che ba seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen grags rgyal/ glo bo mkhan chen/ bdag chen rgya dkar ba/ 'khon nam mkha' bkra shis/

sngags 'chang nyid rab byung gi cha lugs/ bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub dang bsgrigs nas bzhugs pa/ nye gnas kun tshe sogs 'khor skya ser mang po/ rta dre'u/ ja gos dar sogs kyi bzo rtsed du ma dang bcas pa bris sku de thams cad la rgyab gzungs rgyas pa/ sngags 'chang nyid kyis phyag bris su mdzad pa'i war tu'i yi ge chung legs gras shig dang / thams cad kyi mjug na phyag bris dngos kyi/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gdung rin po che'i sgom thag gi dar la/ pir 'dzin rgyal po cha phyi ba dpal ldan dang / dbon rin chen bkra shis/ a 'o chos 'phel te khu tshan gsum gyis bris bkra shis/ zhes pa re re yang phyag bris su mdzad pa'i bris thang de rnams dang / yang gtso bo na ro mkha' spyod la/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ phag mo dkar mo/ grub chen na ro pa/ rje rin chen chos 'phel dpon slob/ pad+ma'i sbub nas khye'u zhig stod nyang nge ba dang bcas pa yod pa'i bri thang / rje rin chen chos 'phel gyis bzhengs nas thugs dam rten rgyun ring mdzad pa/ phyis rje chos dbang phyug dang / rje long ra ba brgyud pa'i mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi phyag tu byung ba bdag gi lag tu babs pa de dang / yang mus chen sems dpa' chen po yan chad kyi nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs yod pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can gcig gshed dmar gyi bris sku rgya gar ma yin nges shig bde ba can gyi zhing bkod che chung gnyis la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'od dpag med la/ 'khor spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje gnyis ldem gyi tshul dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos sogs kyi sku bgrang ba las 'das pa bzhugs pa'i sngon dus kyi bris thang byin rlabs can gnyis dang / sgo rum sgam nag gi rje btsun gong ma'i thugs dam ma'i gras gtso bo rnam rgyal lha dgu la/

gzhan thugs rje chen po/ thub dbang / khyung khra sogs lha zhe gsum tsam yod pa'i sbyin bdag la rje sa chen dang / slob dpon rtse mo gnyis mtshan 'chang 'byar ba bzhugs pa de sogs bris thang byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba de rnams dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi gdung tshwa thub dbang gi sku ju tshe ma/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen gyi sku 'dra gser sku phyag nas ma/ sngags 'chang chen po dbu sil gnang skabs/ chos rje kun bkras kyis phyag phyi zhus pa'i zhal rgyan bubs mang po gzungs rdzongs la bzhugs pa'i sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs nges shig dang / gzhan yang mchod rten rgya gar ma/ 'od dpag med dang / tshe dpag med kyi gser sku mang po/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar chen mo rtsom dus kyi shog ril yongs rdzogs rnams bzhugs so/ /sku brnyan 'di dag bzhengs pa'i legs byas kyis/ /mtshon pa'i bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i bsod nams mthus/ /lus can kun gyi nyes ltung sdig sgrib kun/ /byang nas shes rgyud kha ba dung 'drar shog /de la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med dbang po gsal ba sogs/ /bsam don kun 'grub bstan 'gro'i don mtha' dag /mtha' ru phyin cing re smon kun 'grub shog /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes bsam sbyor kun mthun pas/ /sa lam myur bgrod rang don mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas srid mthar bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces pa'i dkar chag smon lam dang bcas pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi blo mtsho las so/ /'di'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes pa'i bsam 'grub lhas sbyin gyis mgyogs par bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge bar gyur cig /ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi dgongs rdzogs kyi rten bzhengs dus kyi rten gyi gzungs bzhugs dkar chag bzhugs/

/oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi lo dpal sa skya pa chen po grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi nang rten du rgyu rin po che dngul las grub pa'i gdung rten phal thog gnyis lhag tsam yod pa dang / sku tshab lam 'bras brgyud pa'i kha skong du gang sku mda' gang lhag tsam/ gzhan yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i sku chung ngu yongs rdzogs zhal grangs lnga bcu rtsa grangs shig dang / tshe las 'das pa o rgyan bsod nams rgyal mo'i don du 'od dpag med kyi gser sku rkang gang lhag tsam yod pa rnams chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gcig tshun la gegs med du grub pa'i rten so so la nang bzhugs pa'i tho la/ thog mar gdung rten rin po che la steng gzungs/ bar gzungs/ smad gzungs rnams cha tshang bzhugs che ba dang / gdung tshwa la spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan gyi sku gdung la mchod dgu ma che chung 'dres pa sum cu skor dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi gdung tshwa stobs che ba/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i khyu mchog 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid kyi gdung tsha la/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku so gcig 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bcu dgu/ mchod rten mchod dgu ma che ba drug cu re bdun/ chung ba brgya dang gcig tshe dpag med so gcig rnams bzhugs shing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyis sku la rgyun ring bzhes pa'i gsol slog bubs ma nyams pa/ bdag chen rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi gsol phod bubs ma nyams pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / rje btsun gong ma lnga sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi gdung rus/ gdung thal/ na bza' dum bu/ dbu lo sogs stobs che ba/ byin rlabs kun 'dus kyi tsha tsha brgya rtsa ma grangs mang ba/

'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug de nyid kyi sku chos bubs ma nyams pa/ spur sol/ spur spos/ spur tshwa/ spur ras sogs stobs che ba/ bris thang byin rlabs can bzhugs pa la/ theg chen rin po che'i bris sku ta ming rgyal pos bzhengs pa phyag nas ma/ gtso bo bir+wa pa la/ grub thob brgyad cu yongs rdzogs dang / dzam+bha la/ mi g.yo ba/ mgon po lcam dral rnams kyis bskor ba'i dbu steng na rdo rje 'chang gtso 'khor gsum/ gshed dmar yab yum/ phyag rdor/ yi dam khro bo'i sku dang bcas pa sbyin bdag chos rgyal 'phags pa bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa nyid kyi phyag nas ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dkyil thang rgya gar ma bse ston kun rig gi thugs dam ma sgo rum sgam nag nas spyan drangs pa'i byin rlabs can gcig sa lo la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma paṇa chen mi nyag rdo rje'i bris thang sman bla don grub pa'i phyag bris ma sa lo yab sras kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i gtso bo la mi nyag rdo rje/ steng du rje btsun g.yas su kye rdor/ g.yon du bde mchog lū hi pa/ g.yas 'og tu mi g.yo ba dkar po/ g.yon du mi g.yo ba sngon po/ 'og g.yas g.yon du gur mgon lcam dral rnams kyi sku yod pa'i byin rlabs can gcig yang mkhas grub chos rin gyi thugs dam ma 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bris thang gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i lha phran la/ gsang 'dus/ gur mgon lcam dral/ phyag drug lcam dral/ gshed dmar/ 'dzam ser nag 'jam dbyangs/ tshe dpag med sogs mang du yod pa'i byin rlabs can gcig yang 'jam dbyangs sang rin dang / bdag chen rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i gser thang / gtso bo bdag chen rin rgyal ba/ dbu steng du rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ de'i g.yas su 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis/

dpung zur g.yas su 'jam dbyangs/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs/ 'og zur g.yas su 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros dang / rje yon tan dpal 'byor rnams yod pa'i byin rlabs can gcig yang sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma kun 'dus kyi bris thang sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas mang du bzhugs pa'i gtso bo la 'jam dbyangs sa lo chen po/ dbu gtsug na 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ bir+wa pa/ rje btsun/ de 'og na yi dam bde kye/ phur pa/ gur drag gshed dmar rnams dang / sa lo'i g.yas na bdag chen ngag pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis gsum/ g.yon du 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje grol mchog zhabs/ mkhan chen legs blo ba gsum/ sa lo'i 'og na ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ ngor pa sangs rgyas seng ge bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub/ gter ston sprul sku gar dbang gnang tshe ba dang / 'phrang sgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer gnyis/ de rnams kyi 'og tu sbyin bdag sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te yab sras gsum rgyal yum sku mched gnyis dang bcas pa la sku 'khor mang pos bskor ba dang / chos skyong gur lcam dral/ bram gzugs/ pu tra dang bcas pa yod pa'i byin rlabs can gcig 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po mched sku gzhon nu'i dus thugs dam gtor bsngo thog ma rang gnang dus sngags 'chang chen pos gzhal bkod phyag nas sogs mdzad nas gnang ba'i mgon po'i bris thang byin rlabs can gyi gtso bo la gur mgon lha brgyad/ bram gzugs/ rgyud mgon/ 'byung 'dul/ yi dam bde kye/ yang phur/ gur drag gzhan yang dkar bdud lcam dral/ dur khrod bdag po/ bran bdun rnams kyis bskor ba'i dbu steng na/ sa lo dang sngags 'chang chen po rang nyid zhal sprod du bzhugs pa dang / 'og tu 'jam dbyangs sku mched sku 'khor dang bcas pa yod pa'i ye shes pa bzhugs nges gcig rnams bzhugs shing /

'bur sku'i rigs bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma rkang gang tsam rje btsun gyi yum gyi phyi rten nas byon pa'i bzo rgyun rnying ma byin rlabs can gcig chos rje glo bo mkhan chen gyi sku 'dra rje de nyid kyi tshems bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar can gcig jo bo rje'i sku 'dra shing sku rgya gar ma phyag nas 'khrul med gcig thub dbang thog thub ma dang / slob dpon gyi rdza sku gter ma slob dpon nyid kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sku hor sku dngul las grub pa/ sgrol dkar tshe byin ma'i dngul sku byin rlabs che ba/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku 'dra ngor byang 'dren pas bzhengs pa phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs nges gcig yang ngor chen de nyid kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i bse 'bag gi zhal gdong la dpe byas pa'i byin rlabs can gcig yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dngos slob shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam ma spungs sku ngo mtshar can gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa la/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpag med/ sman bla/ klu sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma/ jo bo rje/ 'dzam ser rnams kyis bskor ba'i dbu gtsug tu rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpas mtshan pa dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / yang gsung rab bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun dang 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum thor bu ba sngo spod gser ma po ti gcig dang skya spod gcig rnams bzhugs shing / yang brgyad stong pa sngo spod gser ma byin rlabs che ba/ yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug de nyid kyi sku 'dra che ba la/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid zhal bzhugs dus nged rang la gnang ba'i sku chos bubs ma nyams pa/ rgyun pa'i phyag phreng rag sha 'khrul med rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i spur ras la bzhengs/ rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi bris sku sems dpa' chen po'i phyag nas ma'i gong gsham bsgril shing sogs gling kha mkhan po na rim bzhin gyi sku dreg 'byar ma/

'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i dbu zhwa sgom zhwa bubs ma nyams pa rnams bzhugs shing / sku de nyid dang / 'od dpag med/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i sku chung gra sogs thams cad la stod gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs rnams cha tshang re re/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / bla ma gong ma'i gdung tshwa/ gdung rus/ dbu lo/ na bza'/ bdud rtsi ril bu khri rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo sogs grangs mang ba/ rten 'dam dpe bral ma'i dum bu sogs mdor na gdung rten dang / sku che chung de thams cad byin rlabs kyi gar bu lugs su bzhugs pa la/ nged rang bsnyen song dpon slob rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyis yi dam kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga nyin gang la smin rgyas su bgyis te byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od kyi dpal 'bar bar bstan 'gro'i don du ji srid bskal pa gnas kyi bar du bzhugs su gsol ba 'di la brten nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs shing / bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud la byin rlabs zhugs nas 'di'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig 'dir 'bad dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyis/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don kun/ /'grub nas sa skya'i bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig dag pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du skyes nas gang 'dul gyi/ /sprul pas srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa'i rgyun/ /spyi dang bye brag thams cad rgyas byed shog /de la brten nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las rgya chen po/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di ma lus khyab gyur nas/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces pa'i rten gyi gzung bzhugs kyi dkar chag nyung ngu 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yud tsam zhig la bris pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gdan sa chen po'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus chen dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs bshad las pa rnams kyis legs bshad kyi yig cha gang gi steng nas bshad pa 'bul ba'i bstan bcos kyi tho yig mun sel yar ngo'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi bla ma gong ma'i dus chen dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rnams kyi skabs/ dpon slob rnams gsol ba bzhes pa'i bar la bshad las byed mi rnams kyis bshad pa gang gi steng nas 'bul ba'i yig cha thor btab pa la/ thog mar cho 'phrul zla ba'i sgrub mchod kyi dus/ nged rang gis byas pa'i gsung ngag chos 'byung chen mo legs bshad 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ lam 'bras chos 'byung tshigs bcad ma/ kyai rdor yab yum gyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad chen mo dgyes rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ bdag med bstod pa'i gzhib mchan khog phub dang bcas pa/ yab rkyang gi sgrub thabs rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i rnam thar dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i chu gter rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla gnyis pa'i sgrub mchod kyi dus/ nged rang gis byas pa'i ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed lugs gnyis gsal ba'i nyin byed/ kyai rdor rtsa sngags kyi rnam bshad zab don rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ tshul gsum mdzes rgyan dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan gyi khog phub gnyis/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi khog phub rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi don 'grel zin bris rin chen gter mdzod/ dam tshig gi rnam bshad rig sngags kyi 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa 'khrul spong mdzes rgyan/ sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug tshul chos sgo phyogs brgyar ring du phye ba rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/

zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug gi phur bzlog skabs/ nged rang gis byas pa'i bzlog gzhung gi rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi me chen dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang dang bka' srung gi byon tshul chos skyong dgyes pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo gnyis kyi steng nas zor las pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin bshad pa khor yug tu 'bul/ hor zla bzhi pa'i sgrub mchod kyi skabs/ nged rang gis byas pa'i bde mchog gi chos 'byung bde mchog chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud man ngag 'chad pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos chen po dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar byin rlabs char 'bebs rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla lnga pa'i sgrub mchod dus/ rje mus chen gyi rnam thar chen mo sarga gsum pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed/ rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel tshogs gnyis bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng mdzes/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos 'byung yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ kun rig gi cho ga'i rnam bshad gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gzhung don gsal ba'i sgron me/ gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi lung sbyor rin chen phreng ba ste nged rang gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos de rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i dge tsha'i skabs dang / sgrub mchod kyi dus/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba'i rnam bshad rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/

spyi rnam chen mo mdo sngags bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos de gnyis la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla bdun pa'i sgrub mchod skabs/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad chen mo 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi rnam bshad snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gsal yid 'phrog sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar chen mo ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mgon po'i chos 'byung chen mo bstan srung chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ sa skya pa'i gdung rabs chen mo ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod dgos 'dod kun 'byung rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla dgu pa'i sgrub mchod kyi dus/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i gsang 'dus chos 'byung gsang 'dus chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me 'od rnams la dbu zhabs rdzogs pa rim pa bzhin bshad pa 'bul ba khor yug tu byed/ hor zla bcu pa'i mgon po drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog skabs zor las pa su yin des/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i drug cu pa'i dris lan log rtog 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje'i steng nas rim pa bzhin dbu zhabs rdzogs pa'i bshad pa khor yug tu 'bul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dus mdos chen mo'i mdos rgyag grub pa'i bzhugs gral skabs dang / bkra shis lo gsar chen mo'i skabs rnams su/ mgon po'i chos 'byung / sa skya pa'i gdung rabs sogs sngar smos pa'i legs bshad de rnams gang rigs dang /

bris thang gtso bsdus chen mo/ rdo rje phreng ba nas bshad pa sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs pa'i bris thang / rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong gi bla ma'i sku brnyan sogs ngo mtshar gsar du spel ba'i dkar chag so so la yang dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs bshad kyi dga' ston du spel na rang gzhan kun la bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bskyed cing / bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur te 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gis gsar du brtsams pa'i sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ yo ga chos skyong dang bcas pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun la phan nges kyi lugs kyi bstan bcos chen po de rnams la bshad pa'i rnam dbye shes pa'i phyir dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar thos pas bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i dad pa dang byin rlabs 'byung ba'i slad du/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug sogs rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan par bsams nas/ bya lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba 'dis kyang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub bo// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rang lo so brgyad yan la mgon po'i bsnyen pa song tho bzhugs/ kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen dus yi ge bdun ma 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa dang / bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod du yi ge bdun ma 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa/ gling dga' bde ba can gyi bla ma gong ma na rim gyis gzim chung mdzad pa'i gzim khang de nyid du 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa/

bde mchog pho brang gi sngags 'chang chen po'i gzim chung bde ba can du yi ge bdun ma khri phrag bdun kha skong dang bcas pa/ yang bde mchog pho brang gi gtsug lag khang du yi ge bdun ma 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa/ yang bde mchog pho brang gi gsang ba'i mgon khang du yi ge bdun ma khri phrag bzhi dang / yang de nyid du khri phrag bdun kha skong dang bcas pa/ yang bde mchog pho brang gi mgon khang chen mor yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag bcu bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa/ mgon po'i sbyin sreg byas dus khri phrag bdun kha skong dang bcas pa rnams so/ / 'di yan la yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag bzhi bcu dang khri tsho lnga song 'dug lug mo shing mgon rdo mgon sogs kyi drung du sha sa na bzhi khri kha skong dang bcas pa song / yang rig 'dzin pho brang du yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag gcig dang khri tsho gcig kha skong dang bcas pa dang / yang gnas de nyid du yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag brgyad dang khri tsho bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa song / gzhi bsnyen byas dus kyi mgon po'i bsnyen pa nas bzung ste/ rang lo sum cu yan la mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma sa ya lnga ste/ 'bum phrag lnga bcu thams pa kha mgon po'i bsnyen tshad la/ rab 'bum phrag brgya'am lnga bcu/ 'bring nyi shu rtsa gcig gam rtsa bzhi/ tha ma bdun dang kha skong ba dang brgyad bzlas par gsungs pa'i bsnyen tshad rab tshad gcig yin no/ /yang rig 'dzin pho brang dang mgon khang gong 'og tu sha sa na bzhi khri kha skong dang bcas pa song / yang shing mgon rdo mgon drung rig 'dzin pho brang du 'bum phrag gcig kha skong dang bcas pa song / skong dang bcas pa song / yang bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag gcig da lta yan la 'bum phrag lnga bcu nga gcig song / kha skong dang bcas pa song / yang sgo rum du 'bum phrag gcig dang / rig 'dzin pho brang du 'bum phrag gcig song /

yang bzhi thog rtser 'bum phrag bcu ste brgyad cu gya gcig song / yang 'bum phrag bcu ste dgu bcu go gcig song / yang 'bum phrag bcu ste brgya song bas/ mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma la rang lo so brgyad yan la bye bsnyen thengs gcig song zhing / da dung bye bsnyen lag tu long par shog 'dir smras pa/ sprang po chos med ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /rtag tu rtog 'gyu ngan pa'i rgyun bcad de/ /'khrul ngo snang ba'i snod bcud sna tshogs 'di/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po nag po che'i/ /srung 'khor rten dang brten par gsal btab ste/ /ngo bo nyid gsum man ngag la brten nas/ /sems kyi rang zhal bltas pa'i 'char sgo la/ /shis brjod yul las 'das pa'i rang rig 'di/ /bzung na mi sdod gya gyu rgyug rgyug pa/ /btang tshe mi 'gro lam lam khor khor pa/ /bzhag na mi sdod bun bun long long can/ /brtags na mi rnyed srib srib yal ma yul/ /tshul 'di dang po'i las can 'char sgor gda'/ /yun du bsgoms pas snang phyogs stong phyogs gnyis/ /mtha' ru phyin nas zung 'jug nyams myong ste/ /sngon dus grub chen bud+dha shrī dang / /deng dus kho bo'i bla ma mus pa rje/ /'brel tshad don ldan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan ltar/ /dpe yi ye shes myur du skye bar smon/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //ngam ring chos sder mang ja gser 'gyed gnang dus kyi bsngo yig oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ thub pa'i bstan 'dzin rgya bod mdzes byed pa'i/ /mkhas grub dbang po rim par byon rnams dang / /khyad par gangs ljongs yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas rnams rgyal/ /gzhan yang snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma che/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /mus chen 'khor lo sdom pas bdag skyongs shig /ces mchod par brjod nas/ dpal ngam ring dga' ldan byams pa'i gling gi chos sde chen po 'di nyid du/

sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mang ja zung 'brel nyung ja dang bcas pa dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa bzhi re la gser zho re/ rnam gzhag so so dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i dgos pa/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa dang / skye 'gro mtha' dag bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa'i phyir dang / phan bde'i rtsa lag bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyi dang bye brag rnams zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar du brtan zhing / khyad par sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dpon slob rnams tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can du skyes nas/ slar yang gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du spel ba sogs bsam pa'i don yid la re ba thams cad de kho na ltar 'grub byed bsngo smon shis brjod kyis brgyan pa zhu/ bsngo yig 'di nang gi don rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig phyogs dus kun tu dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ //rdo phreng sogs dkyil thang nyer gcig bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ shing mo bya lo dpal sa skyar rdo rje phreng ba kri ya'i kha skong dang bcas pa/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi/ gur mgon sogs kyi dkyil thang nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor chen po bdun cu don gsum la so so'i bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba dang / de dag gi lha mgron du gong ma lnga/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ rje mus chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams nyer gcig thub pa'i sku nyis brgya dang bdun cu don gcig 'od dpag med kyi sku nyes brgya dang sum cu so bdun/

gnas bcu tshar bcu gcig rnal 'byor ma dgu bcu go bdun/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod brgya dang drug cu re bdun/ tshe dpag med dmar po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gzhan tshe lha'i rigs bcu bzhi ste sum cu so dgu sogs yod pa'i bris thang khyad par can 'di thams cad la gong gsham 'ja' ris rnams jus gser ma dmar ser sngo gsum/ sman tshe/ tshon si sogs kyi zhal kheb sum brtsegs/ bsgril shing gi tog thams cad tsan+dan dmar po 'ba' zhig la byas pa'i dkyil thang nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas bzhengs pa 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring / nad med/ dbang po gsal ba sogs bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / phyi ma dpon slob thams cad lhan cig dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can du pad+mo las brdzus te skyes nas/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la chos nyan te sa lam rnams skad cig gis bgrod nas/ slar yang gang 'dul gyi sprul pas spyi bye brag gi bstan pa dkar 'byams su bya nus pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyi snyan brgyud phyag bzhes ma rnams ma sbas gsal bar bstan pa'i yang gsang ha la nag po'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag bla ma dang zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra ye/ bā la ha ran+t+ra na maḥshrī mahā kā la tsa turmu kha ye a bhik+ṣa pra ṇa na maḥ dngos grub kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam zhi khro rdo rje'i chos skyong tshogs/ /khyad par stobs 'phrog nag po zhal bzhi par/ /gus pas 'dud do bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis 'grogs mdzod la/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/

/bstan pa cher rgyas bsam pa mthar phyin nas/ /phyi ma thogs med bde ba can bgrod mdzod/ /ces mchod par brjod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug dpal stobs 'phrog nag po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyi nying khu yang gsang ha la nag po'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag bri bar bya'o/ /de la yang spyir chos skyong 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang dang / khrid dang / man ngag zab mo'i tshogs rgya gar nas bod du 'gyur zhing rgyun ma chad pa yod do cog phal che ba zhig kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma lnga phrag gcig dang gnyis kyis lhag pa'i drung du/ mkhas pa'i dbang po rdo rje 'chang chen po tshar pa blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud gser chos zab mo rnams kyi bka' bsdu ba po nyid kyis legs par gsan zhing / de dag gi chos skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i dkar chag gsung rgyun pad+ma'i srad bur brgyus pa'i zab don nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba mdzad mod kyang / de dag ni chos sna'i rkang grangs tsam bkod par mdzad pa yin pas lag len gyi gnad rnams brgyud ldan bla ma'i snyan brgyud kho na la ltos dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ dkar chag de nyid las/ 'di dag ni cha shas sam rkang grangs tsam yi ger bkod pa yin gyi/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad phal cher brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i snyan brgyud la ltos pa kho nar snang bas/ man ngag dang bral ba dang lung med kyang dpe tsam la brten nas gzu lum du spyod pa rnams ni mun khung na mda' 'phen pa dang / byis pa gri khar rtse ba dang mtshungs pas shes ldan dag bag yod par byos shig ces gsungs pas so/ /des na zab pa las kyang ches zab cing /

dkon pa las kyang ches dkon pa'i man ngag zab mo'i lag len rnams bstan pa dang rjes 'jug gi bu slob skal ldan rnams la dgongs nas snyan brgyud rnams bklags chog gi tshul gyis gsal bar bstan pa'i ha la nag po'i be'u bum zhes bya ba'i rab tu zab pa'i man ngag gi ma yig bu yig 'di rnams/ rdo rje 'chang chen po tshar pa chos rje nyid kyis mdzad nas skal ldan rnams la spel bar dgongs kyang / 'di'i chos skor rnams la shin tu dam par mdzad pa nas/ man ngag 'di'i ma yig gi lung tsam zhal slob 'ga' zhig gis gsan mod kyang / be'u bum yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po rang nyid kyi yig mkhan sbas pa'i rnal 'byor byams pa don 'grub rgyal mtshan kho na las/ gzhan zhal slob sus kyang ma gsan par brten/ dus phyis bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan nyid kyis dka' ba cher mdzad de/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon par gser sogs zang zing gi dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yon du 'bul bar mdzad nas/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyi drung du be'u bum yongs su rdzogs pa gsan par mdzad nas/ rje de nyid kyi zhal slob don gnyer can 'ga' la man ngag 'di'i ma yig tsam gyi lung gnang ba sogs shin tu dam par mdzad ces gsungs na'ang / kho bo cag gis 'di'i chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa stsol dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ sngon chos rgyal 'phags pas dam pa kun dga' grags la mgon po'i chos skor gnang ba'i tshe/ nged rang gi rigs brgyud gcig la 'phrod par gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis rje rdo ring pa la yang de dang 'dra ba gsungs 'dug pa sogs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa'i gtad mtshams de bzhin yin 'dug kyang /

bar skabs kyi gdung brgyud rnams la chos skyong gi man ngag thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa zhig bzhugs pa dka' bar 'dug kyang / khyed rang la chos skyong gi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa ma lus pa'i bka' bab cing gsan thub 'dug pa dang / lhag par da lan gyi man ngag zab mo'i be'u bum gyi lung 'di nyid yongs su rdzogs par thob pa nged rang ma gtogs deng sang gi dus na gzhan su yang med cing / slob ma gzhan rnams la 'di'i skor rags rim ma gtogs sbyin pa med kyang / da lam ni chos bdag po'i dper 'dug pas yongs su rdzogs pa zhig cis kyang 'bul bas/ man ngag ha la nag po'i be'u bum 'di la dkar chag cig kyang gyis shig ces dgyes pa'i gsung du ma dang bcas thugs rje chen pos legs par stsal ba'i tshe/ rten 'brel legs cha yid ches can byung ba yin pas/ des na yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir 'di'i dkar chag 'bri ba la don gsum ste/ thog mar ha la nag po'i ma yig bu yig gi skor/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i chos skyong 'di'i chos skor gyi dkar chag zab don nor bu'i do shal nas yang zab snying po bsdus pa'i skor/ de las 'phros pa'i man ngag gi skor dang gsum las/ thog mar ha la nag po'i skor la be'u bum gyi ma yig dpal mgon zhing skyong nag po chen po dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs ha la nag po'i be'u bum zhes bya ba'i rtsa ba'i yi ge chen mo/ de'i bu yig gi skor la/ rang bsrung phra mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gi yi ge 'khor lo bri ba'i man ngag gi yi ge srung ba'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gi yi ge bsnyen pa'i sngon 'gro rnam gsum gyi man ngag gi yi ge zhal gdams spu gri so 'debs kyi man ngag gi yi ge gnad la dbab pa rnam pa bzhi'i yi ge rig sngags go ldog gi man ngag gi yi ge

sngags dag par bya ba'i man ngag gi yi ge shi sa bstan pa'i gnad lnga'i man ngag gi yi ge rnams bzhugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ brgyud ldan bla ma'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor/ /rtsod bral gsung gi srad bur brgyus pa yi/ /ha la nag po'i be'u bum zhes bya ba'i/ /nor bu'i phreng 'di kho bo'i skal bas rnyed/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i chos skyong 'di'i chos skor gyi dkar chag zab don nor bu'i do shal nas yang zab snying po bsdus pa'i skor la/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi yi ge dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi khrid yig zung 'jug rnam par rol pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i shan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i yi ge gnyis bzhugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ thog mar rjes su gnang bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /zab khrid bsgom la brtson pas gsang rten mchog /yang yang dran pas stobs 'phrog dbang po yis/ /'bral med skyong ba'i gnad zab 'di ngo mtshar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa de las 'phros pa'i man ngag gi skor la/ gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge gsang khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i yi ge gsang sgrub kyi las sbyor gyi yi ge ches zab yang gsang snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor gyi yi ge dpal tsa turmu kha'i gsang sgrub kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa snying gi yang thig lha mo nag mo'i gnad dbab kyi yi ge chos skyong 'di'i man ngag zab mo nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i bla rdo'i man ngag ces bya ba'i yi ge zhing skyong dbang po'i rnal 'byor pa la nye bar mkho ba'i man ngag zab mo srung 'khor tshe sgrub kyi yi ge tshan pa lnga/ chos skyong 'di'i sgo nas shwa ldog gaṅgā yang gyen la ldog nges par gsungs pa'i dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i shwa ldog gi man ngag gi yi ge

dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i theb bzlog rtsi tshul gyi yi ge khyad par can rnams bzhugs so/ /de ltar gong du bstan pa'i man ngag gi yi ge'i rigs gzhan thams cad ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa yin la/ theb bzlog rtsi tshul gyi man ngag gi yi ge 'di ni bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ zhing skyong zil ldan dbang phyug bsgrub pa la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i bla rdo'i man ngag dang / /mthu rtsal ngom byed shwa bzlog lag len dang / /med thabs med pa'i theb bzlog rtsi tshul gyi/ /zab gnad 'di rnams shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams kyis dpal nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyi snyan brgyud phyag bzhes ma rnams ma sbas pa gsal bar bstan pa'i yang gsang ha la nag po'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag bla ma dang zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa ma lus pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'khrul zad sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams la/ /bstan bsrung dbang po du ma'i bka' babs kyang / /de rnams kun gyi nang nas rab gnyan pa/ /stobs 'phrog zil ldan dbang phyug 'di nyid yin/ /gang de'i man ngag snying thig dkar chag 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pas sbyar/ /sngon tshe bskal bzang dus kyi skye bo rnams/ /chos dang bla ma 'tshol bas rtag tu brel/ /deng sang dus kyi skye bo phal che ba/ /zas nor longs spyod bsgrub pas cher g.yengs nas/ /gal chung dam pa chos kyi bya ba la/ /babs phyir chos dang bla ma'i don gnyer bral/ /'di 'dra mthong tshe bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /da ni 'phel ba'i thabs shig ji ltar bya/ /'on kyang rang nyid skyes sbyangs blo gsal zhing / /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes bzung bas/

/bde skyid rtsa ba sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /'phel bar byed pa'i nus pa cung zad thob/ /de phyir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor tshogs kyi/ /lhag bsam rnam dag ma lus mthar phyin nas/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du spel bar sems/ /tshul 'di dgongs la sa skya'i rje btsun gyis/ /bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad pa'i bstan bsrung rnams/ /bdag cag dpon slob bu sdug ltar skyongs la/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub mdzod/ /'di sbyar dge bas grub mchog bla ma dang / /mthu ldan gdong bzhi gnyan po rab mnyes nas/ /sa skya'i sde dang bstan pa gdung brgyud sogs/ /yid la re ba bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /rang sems bla ma chos skyong dbyer med kyi/ /gnas lugs ngang de yang yang dran pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang slob ma rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag sogs/ /gtan du bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar shog /ces stobs 'phrog zil ldan dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag zab mo ha la nag po'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag 'di yang / rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la sogs te yongs 'dzin bslu ba med pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis shes rgyud tshim pa'i skal ba bzang po can/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos snyan brgyud gdams pa'i rgya mtsho nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas man ngag zab mo'i be'u bum 'di nyid yongs rdzogs kyi bka' drin mnos pa'i tshe/ be'u bum 'di la dkar chag cig gyis shig pa'i bka' stsal spyi bo'i rgyan du blangs te/ me pho stag gi lo gsar du shar ba'i dkar phyogs gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po bzhi thog bla brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/

/'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i bsam don yid la re ba 'di rnams dpal stobs 'phrog dbang po bram ze'i gzugs can gyis thogs med bde blag tu bsgrub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer gyi rus pa la sa tshwa btab pa'i tho bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang dang nye bar gnas pa rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi rus bu la sa tshwa btab pa'i grangs la/ 'jam dbyangs bcu bdun/ tshe dpag med brgya dang bdun/ gong ma lnga tshar lnga sngags 'chang yab sras gsum rje mus chen dang bcas pa tshar lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa lnga bcu/ 'od dpag med brgya dang bcu rnams gzungs dang bcas pa/ nged rang gi lag bstar nas btab pa'i dge bas/ bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa dkar 'byams su bya nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig/ ༈ //sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra dgos 'dod kun 'byung la gzungs bzhugs phul ba'i dkar chag don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rang lo lnga bcu nga brgyad pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta lo bla ma lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i rten gyi gtso bo la/ rig 'dzin lha khang nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu spyan drangs pa'i tshab tu legs par bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi gzungs rdzongs bzhugs pa la/ thog mar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung /

bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dam rdzas kun 'dus kyi thum che ba/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dam rdzas stong rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i dam rdzas 'bum rdo/ brgya rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i dam rdzas 'bum rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo gsum/ bcu rdo lnga/ nged rang gi dam rdzas khri rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo/ bcu rdo sogs stobs che ba/ bla ma gong ma'i dbu lo kun 'dus/ na bza' kun 'dus/ spur rus kun 'dus rnams thum che ba re re/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyun bzhes kyi sbugs ra dri bzang can/ sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang nyid thun mong gi dbu dom/ sngags 'chang chen po zug rgyab mdzad skabs sku la bzhes pa'i sku bem rdo bem du grags pa bubs la nye ba/ yang sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gzan sngon po bubs la nye ba zhig dang / zhabs rgyan/ ang thung / rgyun gyi bla mchod skabs gnang ba'i gos zung dri bzang can/ yang sngags 'chang chen po gtso bor gyur pa dang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po thun mong gi sku bem skyer kha phyi nang sbrags pa bcad skud dang bcas pa bubs ma nyams pa/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsol phyis dmar po bubs ma nyams pa/ rje mus chen gyi sku bem phyi nang sbrags pa bubs ma nyams pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra rgyal rtse nas bdag po ma chen gyis bzhengs pa'i shangs mtshal mar grags pa/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas stong tshar bzhugs nges pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi rigs yod do cog rten 'dam dpe bral ma sogs thams cad 'dus pa'i 'jim pa la nged rang nas sa tsha btab pa brgya rtsa ma gcig ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po/ dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge tshar chen/ ta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel sogs kyi gdung tsha stobs che ba bzhugs shing / bris thang bzhugs pa la/ nye gnas kun tshe bas bzhengs pa'i sa lo chen po gtso bo la sngags 'chang chen po sku chos gnang skabs/

'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang chen po dang / nye gnas kun tshe ba gnyis sgrub khang gcig tu bzhugs nas thugs dam gtor ma lhan du gnang ba'i tshul sogs ngo mtshar can gyi bkod pa dang bcas pa tshan pa gnyis/ rje btsun rin po che/ 'od dpag med/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs khar sa pa ṇi/ gur gyi mgon po sogs kyi lha phran gyis bskor ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ dge slong rin chen rnam grol gyis bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chen po dang / bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub pa gtso bor bzhugs pa la/ steng gi cha la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod lha tshogs dang bcas pa/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ tshe dpag med/ byams pa/ lam 'bras nye brgyud/ gur gyi mgon po/ lha mo/ zhal rnams kyis bskor ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i zhal bkod ma'i sku thang dgu'i gcig gi gtso bo la/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ steng gi cha la sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang chen po 'bral med kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'og na gur gyi mgon po/ lha mo/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa chen/ sgrol dkar/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med kyi tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la slob dpon rin po che/ sa lo sngags 'chang 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la rje btsun rin po che/ sa lo dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sa lo tsā ba dang sngags 'chang chen po 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la bla ma dam pa/ steng na sa lo/ de'i 'og thad na sngags 'chang chen po/ gur mgon/ lha mo/ gcig gi gtso bo la theg chen rin po che/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med kyi tshul du bzhugs pa dang /

gshed dmar/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sku mdun na sngags 'chang chen po/ dmar po skor gsum rnams kyis bskor ba sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la dbu thog na sngags 'chang chen po/ de'i 'og thad na rje btsun rin po che/ 'og phyogs na pu tra chen po rnams bzhugs pa rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i spur gyi zhal gdong gi dar la yab rje nyid kyis zhal bkod mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang chen po'i 'dra sku sgres sha can sbugs ra bsnams pa'i steng na sa lo chen po/ sku mdun na yab rje nyid dang bcas pa'i bris thang la yab rje nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ sgo rum sgam nag nas spyan drangs pa'i kye rdo rje man ngag lugs dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i steng na 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / sa skya pa chen po/ 'og na gur gyi mgon po dang lha mo rnams bzhugs pa'i rje btsun sku mched kyi phyag nas ma 'khrul med/ bal ris kyi bde mchog gtso bo la/ steng gi cha la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ mtha' skor la bde mchog lha tshogs du mas bskor ba jo bo nā ro ta pa'i thugs dam ma yin snyam pa'i ngo mtshar can/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po'i lag nas nged rang du byung ba/ gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad bram gzugs dang bcas pa'i steng gi cha la mgon po brgyud pa bzhugs pa'i bris thang la/ sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas bzhugs pa/ nged rang dbus la phyin skabs zhal bzhi pa'i sku thang lnga tsam byung ba'i nang gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gzigs snang thugs dam ma ras gzhi la chos rje nyid kyi shangs mtshal byugs par mdzad pa'i gnyan mgon dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i zhal bzhi pa gtso 'khor lnga'i bris thang byin rlabs can snye thang chos rdzong nas nged rang gi lag tu byung ba/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags la jo bo rje yab sras/

bka' gdams lha bzhi/ sa chen dang sngags 'chang chen po/ bka' gdams pa'i bla ma drug rnams kyis bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ glo bo mkhan chen gtso bo la/ dkar po rnam gsum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ 'od dpag med/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ steng na rdo ring kun spangs pa/ lam 'bras nye brgyud/ kye rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jigs byed/ tshe dpag med/ ku ru kul+le/ dzam dmar/ bag gdong lcam dral sogs kyis bskor ba rje btsun tshar chen rang gi phyag nas ma/ rdo ring kun spangs pa'i dbon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ 'od dpag med/ kye rdor/ bde mchog rje btsun gong ma lnga/ lam zab brgyud pa/ tshe dpag med/ dmar po skor gsum sogs kyis bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ rje 'gyur med bde chen la tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi brgyud pas bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍ-i ta chen po la bla ma du ma/ kye rdor/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ las gshin/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ dmar po skor gsum/ gur zhal gnyis/ 'dod khams dbang phyug rnam thos sras/ 'jam ser rnams kyis bskor ba dngos grub dpal 'bar ba'i phyag nas ma/ tshe dpag med kyi sku che ba la chung ba bcus bskor ba/ yang tshe dpag med brgya tshar bzhugs pa'i bris thang sogs bzhugs shing / gsung rab bzhugs pa la 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rdo rje gcod pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i mdo/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i mdo sogs mdo sna mang ba/ sa lo chen po'i phyag ris 'khrul med kyi bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mngon rtogs dang dbang chog gnyis/ gur drag gi gzhung / sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rtsom bde mchog dbang chog dang /

gur drag dbang chog sogs phyag ris ma'i dpe che chung 'dres pa spod kha long ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar chen mo'i rtsom gzhi nged rang gis lag bris mang du bgyis pa'i glegs bam/ sngags 'chang chen po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros yab sras gsum zhal ngo nang phan tshun du thugs dam bka' shog gnang ba dang / zhu yig phul ba sogs phyag bris ma 'khrul med sgam chung gang lhag tsam/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos nged rang du gnang ba'i gsung shog phyag bris ma dril che ba gnyis/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang pos/ yum dkar mo lags la gnang ba'i gsung shog phyag bris ma dril che ba gcig yang rje mus chen dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas nged rang du gnang ba'i gsung shog gi rigs grangs mang ba/ gzhan yang rgyud sde nas ji ltar bshad pa ltar gyi dbu gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs rnams bzhugs che ba/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi gar bu lugs su bzhugs pa la nged rang bsnyen song rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob bcu phrag gsum tsam gyis rab tu gnas pa smin rgyas su bgyis te sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dngul gdung chen mo'i drung du bzhugs su gsol ba 'di 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig rnam dkar las 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bla ma yi dam bka' srung gis/ /thogs med dag pa'i zhing du skyel mdzad nas/ /zhing der rang don spangs rtogs mthar phyin te/ /sprul pas spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dkar 'byams byed pa'i mthu ldan shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra dgos 'dod kun 'byung la gzungs gzhug phul ba'i dkar chag don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/

/oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rang lo lnga bcu nga brgyad pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta lo bla ma lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i rten gyi gtso bo la rig 'dzin lha khang nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu spyan drangs pa'i sku tshab tu legs par bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi gzungs rdzongs bzhugs pa la/ thog mar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dam rdzas kun 'dus kyi thum che ba/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dam rdzas stong rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i dam rdzas 'bum rdo/ brgya rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i dam rdzas 'bum rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo gsum/ bcu rdo lnga/ nged rang gi dam rdzas khri rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo/ bcu rdo sogs stobs che ba/ bla ma gong ma'i dbu lo kun 'dus/ na bza' kun 'dus/ spur rus kun 'dus rnams kyi thum che ba re re/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyun bzhes kyi sbug ra dri bzang can/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid thun mong gi dbu dom/ sngags 'chang chen po zug rgyab mdzad skabs sku la bzhes pa'i sku bem rdo bem du grags pa bub la nye ba/ yang sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gzan sngon po bub la nye ba zhig dang / zhabs rgyan/ ang thung / rgyun gyi bla mchod skabs gnang ba'i gos zung dri bzang can/ yang sngags 'chang chen po gtso bor gyur pa dang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po thun mong gi sku bem skyer kha phyi nang sbrags pa bcad skud dang bcas pa bub ma nyams pa/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsol phying dmar po bub ma nyams pa/ rje mus chen gyi sku bem phyi nang sbrags pa bub ma nyams pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra rgyal rtse nas bdag po ma chen gyis bzhengs pa'i shangs mtshal mar grags pa/

sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas stong tshar bzhugs nges pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi rigs yod do cog rten 'dam dpe bral ma sogs thams cad 'dus pa'i 'jim pa la nged rang nas tsha tsha btab pa brgya rtsa ma gcig ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po/ dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge tshar chen/ rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel sogs kyi gdung tsha stobs che ba bzhugs shing / bris thang bzhugs pa la/ nye gnas kun tshe bas bzhengs pa'i sa lo chen po gtso bo la/ sngags 'chang chen po sku chos gnang skabs/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang chen po dang / nye gnas kun tshe ba gnyis sgrub khang gcig tu bzhugs nas thugs dam gtor ma lhan du gnang ba'i tshul sogs ngo mtshar can gyi bkod pa dang bcas pa tshan pa gnyis/ rje btsun rin po che/ 'od dpag med/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs khar sa pa ṇi/ gur gyi mgon po sogs kyi lha phran gyis bskor ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ dge slong rin chen rnam grol gyis bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chen po dang / bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub pa gtso bor bzhugs pa la steng gi cha la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod lha tshogs dang bcas pa/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ tshe dpag med/ byams pa/ lam 'bras nye brgyud/ gur gyi mgon po/ lha mo/ zhal rnams kyis bskor ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i zhal bkod ma'i sku thang dgu'i gcig gi gtso bo la 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ steng gi cha la sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang chen po 'bral med kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'og na gur gyi mgon po/ lha mo/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa chen/ sgrol dkar/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med kyi tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la slob dpon rin po che/ sa lo sngags 'chang 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la rje btsun rin po che/

sa lo dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sa lo tsā ba dang sngags 'chang chen po 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med tshul/ gcig gi gtso bo la bla ma dam pa/ steng na sa lo/ de'i 'og thad na sngags 'chang chen po/ gur mgon/ lha mo/ gcig gi gtso bo la theg chen rin po che/ sa lo chen po dang sngags 'chang nyid 'bral med kyi tshul du bzhugs pa dang / gshed dmar/ gcig gi gtso bo la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sku mdun na sngags 'chang chen po/ dmar po skor gsum rnams kyis bskor ba sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la dbu thog na sngags 'chang chen po/ de'i 'og thad na rje btsun rin po che/ 'og phyogs na pu tra chen po rnams bzhugs pa rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i spur gyi zhal gdong gi dar la yab rje nyid kyis zhal bkod mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang chen po'i 'dra sku bgres sha can sbug ra bsnams pa'i steng na sa lo chen po/ sku mdun na yab rje nyid dang bcas pa'i bris thang la yab rje nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ sgo rum sgam nag nas spyan drangs pa'i kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i steng na 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang sa skya pa chen po/ 'og na gur gyi mgon po dang lha mo rnams bzhugs pa rje btsun sku mched kyi phyag nas ma 'khrul med/ bal ris kyi bde mchog gtso bo la steng gi cha la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ mtha' skor la bde mchog lha tshogs du mas bskor ba jo bo nā ro ta pa'i thugs dam ma yin snyam pa'i ngo mtshar can/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po'i lag nas nged rang du byung ba gur gyi mgon po lha brgya bram gzugs dang bcas pa'i steng gi cha la mgon po brgyud pa bzhugs pa'i bris thang la sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas bzhugs pa/
