nged rang dbus la phyin skabs zhal bzhi pa'i sku thang lnga tsam byung ba'i nang gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gzigs snang thugs dam ma ras gzhi la chos rje nyid kyi shangs mtshal byugs par mdzad pa'i gnyan mgon dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i zhal bzhi pa gtso 'khor lnga'i bris thang byin rlabs can snye thang chos rdzong nas nged rang gi lag tu byung ba/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags la jo bo rje yab sras bka' gdams lha bzhi/ sa chen dang sngags 'chang chen po/ bka' gdams pa'i bla ma drug rnams kyis bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ glo bo mkhan chen gtso bo la/ dkar po rnam gsum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ 'od dpag med/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ steng na rdo ring kun spangs pa/ lam 'bras nye brgyud kyai rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jigs byed/ tshe dpag med/ ku ru kul+le/ dzam dmar/ beg gdong lcam dral sogs kyis bskor ba rje tshar chen rang gi phyag nas ma/ rdo ring kun spangs pa'i dbon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ 'og dpag med/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog rje btsun gong ma lnga/ lam zab brgyud pa/ tshe dpag med/ dmar po skor gsum sogs kyis bskor ba rje de rang gi phyag nas ma/ rje 'gyur med bde chen la tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi brgyud pas bskor ba rje de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la bla ma du ma/ kyai rdor/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ las gshin/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ mi g.yo ba/ dkar po/ dmar po skor gsum/ gur zhal gnyis/ 'dod khams dbang phyug rnam thos sras/ dzam ser rnams kyis bskor ba dngos grub dpal 'bar ba'i phyag nas ma/ tshe dpag med kyi sku che ba la chung ngu bcus bskor ba/ yang tshe dpag med brgya tshar bzhugs pa'i bris thang sogs bzhugs shing /

gsung rab bzhugs pa la/ 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rdo rje gcod pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i mdo/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i mdo sogs mdo sna mang ba/ sa lo chen po'i phyag bris 'khrul med kyi bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mngon rtogs dang / dbang chog gnyis/ gur drag gi gzhung / sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rtsom bde mchog dbang chog dang / gur drag dbang chog sogs phyag bris ma'i dpe che chung 'dres pa pod kha long ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar chen mo'i rtsom gzhi nged rang gi lag bris mang du bgyis pa'i glegs bam/ sngags 'chang chen po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te yab sras gsum zhal ngo nang phan tshun du thugs dam bka' shog gnang ba dang zhu yig phul ba sogs phyag bris ma 'khrul med sgam chung gang lhag tsam/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos nged rang du gnang ba'i gsung shog phyag bris ma dril che ba gnyis/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang pos/ yum dkar mo lags la gnang ba'i gsung shog phyag bris ma dril che ba gcig yang rje mus chen dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas nged rang du gnang ba'i gsung shog gi rigs grangs mang ba/ gzhan yang rgyud sde nas ji ltar bshad pa ltar gyi dbu gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs rnams bzhugs che ba/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi gar bu lugs su bzhugs pa la/ nged rang bsnyen song rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob bcu phrag gsum tsam gyis rab tu gnas pa smin rgyas su bgyis te sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dngul gdung chen mo'i drung du bzhugs su gsol ba 'di phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig rnam dkar las 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/

/phyi ma bla ma yi dam bka' bsrung gis/ /thogs med dag pa'i zhing du bskyel mdzad nas/ /zhing der rang don spangs rtogs mthar phyin te/ /sprul pas spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dkar 'jam byed pa'i mthu ldan shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //gsang sngags bde chen gling du bris thang brab mang ba dge rgyun la sbyar ba'i tho bzhugs/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig gsang sngags bde chen gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyis nges dgos/ nged rang gis sman bla'i skabs dge rgyun du sbyar ba'i sku thang de rnams kyi kha skong du/ mgon po'i bris thang che legs/ tshogs bdag dkar po'i bris thang che legs/ dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs can gyi bris thang byin rlabs can che legs rnams dang / gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris thang tshon khra ma bcu brabs 'di rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams gyis dge ba rgyun chags kyi thebs su bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du sbyar ba'i dgos pa/ zla re bzhin dgu gtor gyi skabs su/ sa skya'i rje btsun bslu med mchog rnams dang / /zhes sogs kyi phrin bcol tshar gsum re dang / bzang po spyod pa/ bdag gi dus gsum ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma rnams tshar re chag med mdzad dgos rgyu yin pa'i do dam rkang len dbu byed dang / chos khrims su byed kyis byed dgos yin pa so so nas nges pa'i spang blang 'tshal/ zhes dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang nas bris// ༈ //dngos grub gling gi mgon khang gi 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge bzhugs pas phrin las rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ mgon khang dngos grub gling 'di nyid dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med yang phur gnyis kyi srung ma chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod 'phreng can mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin pas na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi sku ring la 'khon rog gi thugs dam 'khrul med dkar mo nyi zla'i bris 'bur gyi sku/

spyan gzigs gtor tshogs dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ dus phyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dbang rin chen gyis dkar mo nyi zla'i bris thang gsar bzhengs mdzad de/ de dang dus mnyam du kho bo cag gi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de sku gzhon nu'i dus su sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin phyag bzo 'dres med gnang ba'i thugs dam gtor ma ngo mtshar can gyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di nyid 'dzugs par mdzad cing / de rjes sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis kyang mgon khang gi logs bris sogs zhal bkod phul du phyin pa mdzad pa de dag gi zhabs 'degs dmigs nas/ dkar mo nyi zla'i bris thang rnying ma tshon 'tshogs ma 'khon rog gi thugs dam 'khrul med ri mo ngo mtshar can byin rlabs shin tu che ba 'di nyid dang / gzhan yang phur srung bcu gnyis/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i bris thang lnga po 'di/ 'khon sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du mgon khang dngos grub gling 'dir bzhugs su gsol ba yin pas/ don ma go 'dras bris thang 'di rnams phyi 'khyar byas pa byung na/ dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung bcu gnyis dang bcas pas tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ kal+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ /dbu rtser gser 'phan phul ba'i dkar chag bzhugs/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang gi gtso bo dbu rtse gsar rnying na bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba gdon mi za ba'i yid ches can bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog bgrang ba las 'das pa'i drung du mchod rdzas yid 'phrog rin chen gser gyi lheb mo leb thags su byas pa lta bu'i gos 'phan ngo mtshar can bcu phrag gsum dang / lnga phrag gcig gis lhag pa 'dis gtsos pa'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di dag

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad gus chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'bul la/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ bde mchog pho brang gi gtsug lag khang mgon khang dang bcas pa zhig gso byas pa'i dkar chag bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra shrī dharma swa mi ye na maḥ rdo rje 'chang dngos mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po dang / /de sras mkha' spyod dbang po bsod nams rtse/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i mtshan rnams phyag gi gnas/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen dang / /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /kun dga' rin chen rnam thar bsam bzhin dad/ /gang gi thugs sras bsod nams dbang po dang / /sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab grags pa'i mtshan/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byang chub bar du skyobs/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang 'di nyid sngon slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo bde ba can du gshegs pa'i gzim khang gi shul du/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' bzhin/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gtsug lag khang skyed mos tshal dang bcas pa sngon med gsar du bskrun par mdzad de/ lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing gzhan las ngo mtshar che bar bzhugs pa las/

dus phyis lo mang lon pa dang / me tog ra ba'i nyer mkho'i chu rnams bzhu 'khyags kyi dbang las/ lha khang mgon khang sogs shin tu nyen pas nyams gso'i zhabs tog mi byed ka med shar ba nas/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma spyi dang / khyad par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas blang ste/ lha khang steng 'og gi logs kyi bris sku rnams la arga'i cho ga bla ma'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin bgyis te/ gtsug lag khang gi 'gram rtsa ba nas bslangs te/ brtan zhing brjid chags pa/ lhun po lta bur bgyis pa'i bla ma lha khang du bris sku sngar yod rnams ma nyams pa'i steng / kha skong gi bla ma'i sku mang po dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod sogs gsar du bzhengs te/ bla ma'i sku bris 'bur sdom pa'i/ sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kyai gnyis kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa cha tshang ba bar ma chad pa bzhugs par byas shing / mgon khang du yang sngar kyi logs bris kyi sku rags bsdus yod pa rnams nyams med kyi steng du/ gur gyi mgon po/ 'dod khams lha mo gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs/ zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa dang / mgon po rang gi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi bris sku gsar du bzhengs te/ nged rang rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob rnams kyis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du bgyis te/ 'gro ba lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa 'di ni/ rgya gar lugs la yu bā zhes bya zhing / rgya nag lugs la shing mo phag gi lo gtsug lag khang gi 'grams bting pa nas bzung 'phags pa'i yul du dhā raḥzhes grags shing / rgya nag pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo'i smin drug gi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la gegs med du grub pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du bde legs su gyur cig

legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /shin tu lus brtas dbang po rab gsal bas/ /sngar bzhin sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed shog /rigs brgyud gtsang ma lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /myur du 'byung zhing de dag brgyud bcas kyis/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun 'di nyid/ /legs par 'dzin zhing gong nas gong 'phel shog /chos med bdag dang bdag la yid gtad pa'i/ /gdul byar bcas rnams phyi ma lhan cig par/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du legs skye zhing / /bsam yas sprul pas srid mthar bstan 'dzin shog /shu bham̐ mastu sarba dza ga tam̐// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgron me/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
